title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三: 太宗下 Volume 3 Annals 3: Taizong 2

sentences.zh: 貞觀四年四年春正月乙亥，定襄道行軍總管李靖大破突厥，獲隋皇后蕭氏及煬帝之孫正道，送至京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on yihai, Li Jing, commander-in-chief of the Dingxiang campaign, routed the Turks, captured Sui Empress Xiao and Yangdi's grandson Zhengdao, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenguan, on yihai of the first spring month, Li Jing, commander of the Dingxiang campaign, crushed the Turks, took Sui Empress Xiao and Yangdi's grandson Zhengdao prisoner, and sent them to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武德殿北院火。

translations.literal: On guisi, fire broke out in the north courtyard of Wude Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a fire consumed the north courtyard of Wude Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the second month the emperor went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李靖又破突厥於陰山，頡利可汗輕騎遠遁。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Jing again defeated the Turks at Yinshan; Illig Khagan fled far with a light escort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Jing routed the Turks again at Yinshan, and Illig Khagan fled into the distance with only a few horsemen.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦，賜酺五日。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a great amnesty was proclaimed and communal feasting was granted for five days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he proclaimed a general amnesty and granted five days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 民部尚書戴胄以本官檢校吏部尚書，參預朝政。

translations.literal: Dai Zhou, Minister of Popular Affairs, while retaining that office checked and supervised the Ministry of Personnel and took part in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Zhou, minister of popular affairs, was ordered to supervise the Ministry of Personnel in addition to his own post and to join in deliberating state affairs.

sentences.zh: 太常卿蕭瑀為御史大夫，與宰臣參議朝政。

translations.literal: Xiao Yu, Director of Imperial Sacrifices, became Censor-in-Chief and deliberated court affairs with the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, director of imperial sacrifices, was made censor-in-chief and joined the chief ministers in governing.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫、西河郡公溫彥博為中書令。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo, Censor-in-Chief and Duke of Xihe Commandery, became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo, censor-in-chief and Duke of Xihe, was appointed director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，大同道行軍副總管張寶相生擒頡利可汗，獻於京師。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, Zhang Baoxiang, deputy commander of the Datong campaign, captured Illig Khagan alive and presented him at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the third month Zhang Baoxiang, deputy commander on the Datong front, took Illig Khagan alive and brought him to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 甲申，尚書右僕射、蔡國公杜如晦薨。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Du Ruhui, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Cai, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Du Ruhui, right vice director and Duke of Cai, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以俘頡利告於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the capture of Illig was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court reported Illig's capture to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，御順天門，軍吏執頡利以獻捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingyou, he took his seat at Shuntian Gate while military officers led Illig forward to present the victory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the fourth summer month he sat at Shuntian Gate as officers marched Illig forward to present the triumph.

sentences.zh: 自是西北諸蕃咸請上尊號為「天可汗」，於是降璽書冊命其君長，則兼稱之。

translations.literal: Thereafter the tribes of the northwest all asked to honor him with the title "Heaven Khagan"; he then sent imperial writs to invest their chieftains, who might also bear that title.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the northwestern peoples asked to call him Heaven Khagan; he sent imperial patents to their rulers, who might use the title alongside their own.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiazi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the seventh autumn month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 上謂房玄齡、蕭瑀曰：「隋文何等主？

translations.literal: The emperor said to Fang Xuanling and Xiao Yu, "What sort of ruler was Sui Wendi?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Fang Xuanling and Xiao Yu, "What manner of ruler was Emperor Wen of Sui?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「克己復禮，勤勞思政，每一坐朝，或至日昃。

translations.literal: They replied, "He restrained himself and returned to ritual propriety, labored diligently over government and policy, and at each court session sometimes sat until the sun had declined.
translations.idiomatic: They answered, "He disciplined himself and honored the rites, toiled over policy, and often held court until the sun was low in the west.

sentences.zh: 五品已上，引之論事。

translations.literal: Officials of the fifth rank and above he summoned to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He called in officials of the fifth rank and above to debate affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 宿衛之人，傳餐而食。

translations.literal: Palace guards passed meals hand to hand while they ate.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guards ate their meals in relays, passing food along the line.

sentences.zh: 雖非性體仁明，亦勵精之主也。

translations.literal: Though not by nature benevolent and perspicacious, he was still a ruler who strove to refine his spirit."
translations.idiomatic: He was not by nature humane and luminous, yet he was a ruler who drove himself to excel."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「公得其一，未知其二。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "You grasp one part and do not know the second.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You see one side of him, not the other.

sentences.zh: 此人性至察而心不明。

translations.literal: This man's nature was excessively keen in scrutiny yet his mind was not clear.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was piercingly suspicious, yet his judgment was clouded.

sentences.zh: 夫心暗則照有不通，至察則多疑於物。

translations.literal: When the mind is dark, illumination cannot reach everywhere; when scrutiny is extreme, one grows doubtful of all things.
translations.idiomatic: A dark mind cannot see far; excessive scrutiny breeds doubt in everything.

sentences.zh: 自以欺孤寡得之，謂群下不可信任，事皆自決，雖勞神苦形，未能盡合於理。

translations.literal: Because he had won the throne by deceiving the orphaned and widowed, he believed his subordinates could not be trusted; he decided every matter himself, and though he wore out spirit and body, he could not wholly accord with reason.
translations.idiomatic: Having seized power by tricking the bereaved court, he trusted no one beneath him, decided everything alone, and though he exhausted mind and body, his rule still missed the mark.

sentences.zh: 朝臣既知上意，亦復不敢直言，宰相已下，承受而已。

translations.literal: Once the courtiers knew the sovereign's mind, they again dared not speak plainly; from the chancellor down, they merely received orders and carried them out.
translations.idiomatic: Once ministers knew what he wanted, they dared not speak plainly; from the chancellor down, they only took orders and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 朕意不然。

translations.literal: My view is not so.
translations.idiomatic: I do not think that way.

sentences.zh: 以天下之廣，豈可獨斷一人之慮？

translations.literal: With a realm so vast, how can one man's judgment decide all?
translations.idiomatic: How can one man's wit govern a realm this wide?

sentences.zh: 朕方選天下之才，為天下之務，委任責成，各盡其用，庶幾於理也。

translations.literal: I am now selecting talent from across the empire for the empire's tasks, entrusting offices and demanding results, each to use his utmost—then we may approach good order."
translations.idiomatic: I mean to choose the best people in the land for the land's work, give them charge, hold them to results, and let each serve where he excels—only then can we hope for right rule."

sentences.zh: 」因令有司：「詔敕不便於時，即宜執奏，不得順旨施行。

translations.literal: He thereupon ordered the responsible offices: "Whenever an edict or command is ill-suited to the times, you should memorialize against it at once and must not carry it out merely to please my intent."
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the offices: "If any edict does not suit the times, memorialize against it immediately; do not obey my whim."
[End of the order.]

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，詔三品已上服紫，五品已上服緋，六品七品以綠，八品九品以青；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu, an edict ordered that officials of the third rank and above wear purple, those of the fifth rank and above wear scarlet, ranks six and seven green, and ranks eight and nine blue;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the eighth month an edict fixed court colors: third rank and above in purple, fifth rank and above in scarlet, sixth and seventh in green, eighth and ninth in blue;

sentences.zh: 婦人從夫色。

translations.literal: women were to follow their husbands' colors.
translations.idiomatic: and wives were to dress in their husbands' colors.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，兵部尚書、代國公李靖為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Jing, Minister of War and Duke of Dai, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Jing, minister of war and Duke of Dai, was made left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，令收瘞長城之南骸骨，仍令致祭。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu, he ordered the gathering and burial of bones south of the Great Wall and that sacrifices be offered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the ninth month he ordered the bones scattered south of the Great Wall collected, buried, and mourned.

sentences.zh: 壬午，令自古明王聖帝、賢臣烈士墳墓無得芻牧，春秋致祭。

translations.literal: On renwu, he ordered that the tombs of sage emperors and kings, worthy ministers, and martyred heroes of old must not be pastured or cut for fodder, and that sacrifices be offered in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he forbade grazing or cutting fodder on the graves of ancient sage rulers, worthy ministers, and loyal dead, and required spring and autumn offerings at their tombs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，幸隴州，曲赦隴、岐二州，給復一年。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renchen, he visited Long Prefecture, granted a partial amnesty to Long and Qi prefectures, and remitted taxes for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the tenth winter month he visited Longzhou, pardoned Long and Qi in part, and granted a year's tax relief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，校獵於貴泉穀。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he conducted a hunting review at Guiquan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he held a hunt at Guiquan Valley.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，校獵於魚龍川，自射鹿，獻於大安宮。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he conducted a hunting review at Yulong River, shot a deer himself, and presented it at D'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted at Yulong River, shot a deer with his own bow, and sent it as tribute to D'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至自隴州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he returned from Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he returned from Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，制決罪人不得鞭背，以明堂孔穴針灸之所。

translations.literal: On wuyin, a statute forbade flogging condemned persons on the back, because the Hall of Enlightenment's acupoints are sites for needle therapy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he decreed that convicts must not be flogged on the back, the locus of acupuncture points at the Hall of Enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書侯君集參議朝政。

translations.literal: Hou Junji, Minister of War, took part in deliberating court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Junji, minister of war, joined in governing.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，開府儀同三司、淮安王神通薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinhai, Li Shentong, Generalissimo with the Golden Seal and Duke of Huai'an, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the twelfth month Li Shentong, generalissimo with the golden seal and Prince of Huai'an, died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，高昌王麴文泰來朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Qu Wentai, king of Gaochang, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Qu Wentai, king of Gaochang, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 是歲，斷死刑二十九人，幾致刑措。

translations.literal: That year, twenty-nine persons were sentenced to death—nearly achieving the abolition of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: That year only twenty-nine people were executed—punishment all but fell into disuse.

sentences.zh: 東至於海，南至於嶺，皆外戶不閉，行旅不賚糧焉。

translations.literal: East to the sea, south to the mountains, outer doors were left unbarred and travelers went without carrying provisions.
translations.idiomatic: From the eastern sea to the southern ranges, outer gates stood unlatched and travelers needed no grain on the road.

sentences.zh: 貞觀五年五年正月癸酉，大蒐於昆明池，蕃夷君長咸從。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhenguan, in the first month, on guiyou, a great hunt was held at Kunming Pool; chieftains of the barbarian tribes all followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhenguan, on guiyou of the first month, he held a grand hunt at Kunming Pool with foreign chieftains in attendance.

sentences.zh: 丙子，親獻禽於大安宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he personally presented game at D'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he presented the hunt's kill in person at D'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸左藏庫，賜三品已上帛，任其輕重。

translations.literal: On jimao, he visited the Left Treasury and bestowed silk on officials of the third rank and above, letting each take as much or as little as he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he opened the Left Treasury and gave silk to every official of third rank and above, each free to choose his portion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，朝集使請封禪。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the assembly envoys requested a feng and shan sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the provincial assembly envoys petitioned for a feng and shan rite.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封皇弟元裕為鄶王，元名為譙王，靈夔為魏王，元祥為許王，元曉為密王。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the emperor's younger brothers were enfeoffed: Yuan Yu as Prince of Zheng, Yuanming as Prince of Qiao, Lingchai as Prince of Wei, Yuanxiang as Prince of Xu, and Yuanxiao as Prince of Mi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he enfeoffed his brothers: Yuan Yu Prince of Zheng, Yuanming Prince of Qiao, Lingchai Prince of Wei, Yuanxiang Prince of Xu, and Yuanxiao Prince of Mi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封皇子愔為梁王，貞為漢王，惲為郯王，治為晉王，慎為申王，囂為江王，簡為代王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the princes were enfeoffed: Yin as Prince of Liang, Zhen as Prince of Han, Yun as Prince of Tan, Zhi as Prince of Jin, Shen as Prince of Shen, Xiao as Prince of Jiang, and Jian as Prince of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he enfeoffed his sons: Yin Prince of Liang, Zhen Prince of Han, Yun Prince of Tan, Zhi Prince of Jin, Shen Prince of Shen, Xiao Prince of Jiang, and Jian Prince of Dai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，代王簡薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renchen, Prince Jian of Dai died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the fourth summer month Prince Jian of Dai died.

sentences.zh: 以金帛購中國人因隋亂沒突厥者男女八萬人，盡還其家屬。

translations.literal: With gold and silk he ransomed eighty thousand men and women of the Central States who, because of Sui disorder, had fallen into Turkic hands, and returned them all to their families.
translations.idiomatic: He paid gold and silk to redeem eighty thousand Chinese men and women enslaved among the Turks during the Sui collapse and sent them home to their kin.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，太子少師、新昌縣公李綱薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiayin, Li Gang, Junior Tutor to the crown prince and Duke of Xinchang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the sixth month Li Gang, junior tutor to the crown prince and Duke of Xinchang, died.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，遣使毀高麗所立京觀，收隋人骸骨，祭而葬之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiachen, he sent envoys to destroy the victory mounds Goguryeo had raised, gathered the bones of Sui dead, sacrificed to them, and buried them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the seventh month he sent envoys to tear down Goguryeo's victory mounds, collect Sui dead, mourn them, and bury them with honor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，初令天下決死刑必三覆奏，在京諸司五覆奏，其日尚食進蔬食，內教坊及太常不舉樂。

translations.literal: On wushen, for the first time he ordered that death sentences empire-wide must receive threefold review; in the capital the offices must review five times; on that day the Imperial Kitchen served vegetarian food, and the Inner Music Office and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices performed no music.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he first required three reviews before any execution in the realm, five in the capital; on execution days the palace kitchen served only vegetables and court music fell silent.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，賜群官大射於武德殿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yichou, he granted the officials a great archery contest at Wude Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the ninth month he held a grand archery feast for the officials at Wude Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，右衛大將軍、順州都督、北平郡王阿史那什缽苾卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Ashina Shibobi, General-in-Chief of the Right Guard, Governor of Shun Prefecture, and Prince of Beiping, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Ashina Shibobi, general of the right guard, governor of Shunzhou, and Prince of Beiping, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renyin, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the twelfth month he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，獵於驪山。

translations.literal: On guimao, he hunted at Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he hunted on Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜新豐高年帛有差。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he bestowed silk on the aged of Xinfeng in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he gave graded gifts of silk to the elderly of Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On wushen, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 貞觀六年六年春正月乙卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on the yimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhenguan, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，置三師官員。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingxu, the offices of the Three Preceptors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the second month he established the Three Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 戊子，初置律學。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Law School was established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he founded the school of law.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuchen, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the third month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，酆王元亨薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jihai, Prince Yuanheng of Feng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the sixth month Prince Yuanheng of Feng died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，江王囂薨。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Prince Xiao of Jiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Prince Xiao of Jiang died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yimao, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the tenth winter month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，親錄囚徒，歸死罪者二百九十人於家，令明年秋末就刑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, he personally reviewed prisoners and sent two hundred ninety persons sentenced to death home, ordering execution in the autumn of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the twelfth month he reviewed prisoners in person and sent two hundred ninety condemned men home to await execution the next autumn.

sentences.zh: 其後應期畢至，詔悉原之。

translations.literal: Thereafter, when the appointed time arrived, they all came in; an edict wholly pardoned them.
translations.idiomatic: When autumn came they all returned as ordered, and he pardoned every one of them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，黨項羌前後內屬者三十萬口。

translations.literal: That year, before and after, three hundred thousand Tangut submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year three hundred thousand Tangut submitted in successive waves.

sentences.zh: 貞觀七年七年春正月戊子，詔曰：「宇文化及弟智及、司馬德戡、裴虔通、孟景、元禮、楊覽、唐奉義、牛方裕、元敏、薛良、馬舉、元武達、李孝本、李孝質、張愷、許弘仁、令狐行達、席德方、李覆等，大業季年，咸居列職，或恩結一代，任重一時；

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on wuzi, an edict said: "Yuwen Huazhi's brother Zhiyi, Sima Dekan, Pei Qiantong, Meng Jing, Yuan Li, Yang Lan, Tang Fengyi, Niu Fangyu, Yuan Min, Xue Liang, Ma Ju, Yuan Wuda, Li Xiaoben, Li Xiaozhi, Zhang Kai, Xu Hongren, Linghu Xingda, Xi Defang, Li Fu, and others—in the closing years of Daye all held court rank, some bound by grace to a generation, some bearing weight for a season;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhenguan, on wuzi of the first spring month, an edict named Yuwen Zhiyi, Sima Dekan, Pei Qiantong, and the rest who, in Yangdi's last years, had held high office—men once favored by the throne—

sentences.zh: 乃包藏兇慝，罔思忠義，爰在江都，遂行弒逆，罪百閻、趙，釁深梟獍。

translations.literal: yet they harbored fierce wickedness and gave no thought to loyalty; at Jiangdu they carried out regicide, crimes surpassing Yan and Zhao, guilt deeper than the parricide-beast.
translations.idiomatic: yet at Jiangdu they murdered their sovereign, crimes blacker than regicide itself.

sentences.zh: 雖事是前代，歲月已久，而天下之惡，古今同棄，宜置重典，以勵臣節。

translations.literal: Though the deed belongs to a former dynasty and the years are long, the evil under heaven is rejected in every age; a heavy statute should be set to steel the hearts of ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Though the deed lies in the past, such evil is condemned in every age; let the law be severe to warn those who serve.

sentences.zh: 其子孫並宜禁錮，勿令齒敘。

translations.literal: Their sons and grandsons should all be placed under restraint and barred from official advancement."
translations.idiomatic: Their sons and grandsons shall be barred from office and from mingling in court ranks."

sentences.zh: 」是日，上制《破陣樂舞圖》。

translations.literal: That same day, the emperor composed the dance tableau Breaking the Battle Line.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he composed the dance tableau Breaking the Battle Line.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜京城酺三日。

translations.literal: On xinchou, communal feasting was granted in the capital for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he granted three days of public feasting in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，雨土。

translations.literal: On dingmao, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，薛延陀遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On yiyou, envoys from Xueyantuo came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Xueyantuo sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，秘書監、檢校侍中魏徵為侍中。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Wei Zheng, Director of the Secretariat and acting Palace Attendant, became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wei Zheng, director of the Secretariat and acting palace attendant, was made palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，直太史、將仕郎李淳風鑄渾天黃道儀，奏之，置於凝暉閣。

translations.literal: On guisi, Li Chunfeng, Director of the Imperial Observatory and Gentleman for Court Service, cast the armillary sphere of the Yellow Path, presented it, and it was placed in Ninghui Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Chunfeng cast the armillary sphere of the yellow path, presented it to the throne, and it was installed in Ninghui Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the fifth summer month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月，山東、河南三十州大水，遣使賑恤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, thirty prefectures east and south of the mountains suffered great floods; envoys were sent to relieve and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month thirty prefectures east and south of the mountains were flooded; he sent envoys with relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the tenth winter month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，頒新定《五經》。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, the newly revised Five Classics were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the eleventh month he promulgated the newly fixed Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，開府儀同三司、齊國公長孫無忌為司空。

translations.literal: On renchen, Zhangsun Wuji, Generalissimo with the Golden Seal and Duke of Qi, became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhangsun Wuji, generalissimo with the golden seal and Duke of Qi, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，狩於少陵原，詔以少牢祭杜如晦、杜淹、李綱之墓。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, he hunted at Shaoling Plain and ordered the secondary sacrifice offered at the tombs of Du Ruhui, Du Yan, and Li Gang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the twelfth month he hunted on Shaoling Plain and ordered secondary sacrifices at the tombs of Du Ruhui, Du Yan, and Li Gang.

sentences.zh: 貞觀八年八年正月癸未，右衛大將軍阿史那吐苾卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhenguan, in the first month, on guiwei, Ashina Tubo, General-in-Chief of the Right Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhenguan, on guiwei of the first month, Ashina Tubo, general of the right guard, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，右屯衛大將軍張士貴討東、西五洞反獠，平之。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Zhang Shigui, General-in-Chief of the Right Garrison Guard, suppressed the rebel Liao of the eastern and western Five Caves and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhang Shigui, general of the right garrison guard, crushed the rebel Liao of the eastern and western Five Caves.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命尚書右僕射李靖、特進蕭瑀楊恭仁、禮部尚書王珪、御史大夫韋挺、鄜州大都督府長史皇甫無逸、揚州大都督府長史李襲譽、幽州大都督府長史張亮、涼州大都督李大亮、右領軍大將軍竇誕、太子左庶子杜正倫、綿州刺史劉德威、黃門侍郎趙弘智使於四方，觀省風俗。

translations.literal: On renyin, he appointed Li Jing, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Xiao Yu and Yang Gongren, Senior Advisors; Wang Gui, Minister of Rites; Wei Ting, Censor-in-Chief; Huangfu Wuyi, chief administrator of the metropolitan prefecture of Bian; Li Xiyu, chief administrator of Yangzhou; Zhang Liang, chief administrator of Youzhou; Li Daliang, metropolitan protector of Liangzhou; Dou Dan, General-in-Chief of the Right Vanguard; Du Zhenlun, left aide to the crown prince; Liu Dewei, prefect of Mian; and Zhao Hongzhi, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate, as envoys to the four quarters to observe local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he dispatched Li Jing, Xiao Yu, Yang Gongren, Wang Gui, Wei Ting, Huangfu Wuyi, Li Xiyu, Zhang Liang, Li Daliang, Dou Dan, Du Zhenlun, Liu Dewei, and Zhao Hongzhi to tour the realm and report on local custom.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，皇太子加元服。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yisi, the crown prince received the cap of manhood.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the second month the crown prince came of age.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜天下酺三日。

translations.literal: On bingwu, communal feasting was granted throughout the empire for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he granted three days of public feasting empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the third month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the fifth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上初服翼善冠，貴臣服進德冠。

translations.literal: On dingchou, for the first time the emperor wore the Yishan crown and nobles wore the Jinde crown.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he first wore the Yishan crown himself and required nobles to wear the Jinde crown.

sentences.zh: 七月，始以雲麾將軍階為從三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Cloud Pennon General rank was made subordinate third rank for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the rank of Cloud Pennon General was fixed at subordinate third grade.

sentences.zh: 隴右山崩，大蛇屢見。

translations.literal: In Longyou the mountains collapsed and great serpents were repeatedly seen.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains collapsed in Longyou and great serpents were seen again and again.

sentences.zh: 山東、河南、淮南大水，遣使賑恤。

translations.literal: East and south of the mountains and in Huainan there were great floods; envoys were sent to relieve and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck the eastern and southern provinces and Huainan; he sent envoys with relief.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，有星孛於虛、危，歷於氐，十一月上旬乃滅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiazi, a broom star appeared in Xu and Wei, passed through Di, and was extinguished in the first ten days of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth month a comet blazed in Xu and Wei, crossed Di, and vanished in the first third of the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，皇太子來朝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou, the Crown Prince came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou day, the Crown Prince presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，右驍衛大將軍、褒國公段志玄擊吐谷渾，破之，追奔八百餘里。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth month, Right Valiant Cavalry Guard General and Duke of Bao State Duan Zhixuan attacked the Tuyuhun, defeated them, and pursued the fleeing enemy for more than eight hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Duan Zhixuan, right guard general and Duke of Bao, struck the Tuyuhun, broke them, and chased the fugitives more than eight hundred li.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，右僕射、代國公李靖以疾辭官，授特進。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Right Deputy Director Li Jing, Duke of Dai State, resigned his office owing to illness and was granted the honorary rank of Special Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eleventh month, Li Jing, right vice director and Duke of Dai, resigned for illness and was made Special Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，吐谷渾寇涼州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Tuyuhun raided Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Tuyuhun raided Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吐谷渾拘我行入趙道德。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Tuyuhun seized and detained the imperial envoy Zhao Daode.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou they seized the Tang envoy Zhao Daode.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，命特進李靖、兵部尚書侯君集、刑部尚書任城王道宗、涼州都督李大亮等為大總管，各帥師分道以討吐谷渾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, he appointed Special Guardian Li Jing, Minister of War Hou Junji, Minister of Punishments Prince Daizong of Rencheng, Liangzhou Protector Li Daliang, and others as supreme commanders, each leading troops by separate routes to attack the Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the twelfth month he named Li Jing, Hou Junji, Prince Daizong of Rencheng, Li Daliang of Liangzhou, and others supreme commanders to strike the Tuyuhun by separate columns.

sentences.zh: 壬子，越王泰為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On renzi, Prince of Yue Tai was made Prefect of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince Tai of Yue became Yongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，帝從太上皇閱武於城西。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor in reviewing troops west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Emperor joined the Retired Emperor to review troops west of the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，龜茲、吐蕃、高昌、女國、石國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year envoys came from Kucha, Tibet, Gaochang, the Women's State, and the Stone Kingdom bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Kucha, Tibet, Gaochang, the Women's Kingdom, and Shazhou sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 貞觀九年九年春三月，洮州羌叛，殺刺史孔長秀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the third month, the Qiang of Tao Prefecture rebelled and killed the prefect Kong Changxiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, in the third spring month, the Qiang of Tao Prefecture rebelled and slew Prefect Kong Changxiu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On renwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 每鄉置長一人，佐二人。

translations.literal: In every district one chief was appointed, with two assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Each district received one chief and two assistants.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鹽澤道總管高甑生大破叛羌之眾。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Gao Zengsheng, supreme commander on the Salt Lake route, inflicted a great defeat on the rebel Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Gao Zengsheng, commander on the Salt Lake route, crushed the rebel Qiang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕天下戶立三等，未盡升降，置為九等。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict ordered households throughout the realm classified in three grades, with those not yet fully promoted or demoted arranged in nine grades.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he decreed a three-grade household system nationwide, with finer distinctions of nine grades where promotion or demotion was still pending.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，康國獻獅子。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, Kang presented a lion.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the fourth summer month Kang presented a lion.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dingmao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingmao, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大總管李靖、侯君集、李大亮、任城王道宗破吐谷渾於牛心堆。

translations.literal: On guisi, supreme commanders Li Jing, Hou Junji, Li Daliang, and Prince Daizong of Rencheng defeated the Tuyuhun at Niuxindui.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Jing, Hou Junji, Li Daliang, and Prince Daizong broke the Tuyuhun at Niuxindui.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，又破之於烏海，追奔至柏海。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiwei, they defeated them again at Wuhai and pursued the fugitives to Baihai.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the fifth month they beat them again at Wuhai and chased the fugitives to Baihai.

sentences.zh: 副總管薛萬均、薛萬徹又破之於赤水源，獲其名王二十人。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders Xue Wanjun and Xue Wanche defeated them again at Chishuiyuan and captured twenty of their famed kings.
translations.idiomatic: Deputies Xue Wanjun and Xue Wanche routed them at Chishuiyuan and took twenty of their great chieftains.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太上皇崩於大安宮。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Retired Emperor died at Da'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Retired Emperor died at Da'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，李靖平吐谷渾於西海之上，獲其王慕容伏允。

translations.literal: On renzi, Li Jing pacified the Tuyuhun west of the sea and captured their king Murong Fuyun.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Jing pacified the Tuyuhun beyond the western sea and seized King Murong Fuyun.

sentences.zh: 以其子慕容順光降，封為西平郡王，復其本國。

translations.literal: Because his son Murong Shun had submitted, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping Commandery and their native state was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shun, who had surrendered, was made Prince of Xiping and the Tuyuhun realm was restored under him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，增修太廟為六室。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiayin, the Ancestral Temple was enlarged to six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the seventh autumn month the Ancestral Temple was expanded to six chambers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，葬高祖太武皇帝於獻陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengyin, Gaozu the Grand Martial Emperor was buried at Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the tenth winter month Gaozu the Grand Martial Emperor was buried at Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: On wushen, his tablet was placed in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen his spirit tablet was installed in the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，左僕射、魏國公房玄齡加開府儀同三司，餘如故。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Left Deputy Director Fang Xuanling, Duke of Wei State, was additionally made Bearer of the Protocol of the Opening of the Office with the Same Ceremonials as the Three Excellencies, his other offices remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fang Xuanling, left vice director and Duke of Wei, received supernumerary Three-Excellency ceremonial rank; his other posts were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，吐谷渾西平郡王慕容順光為其下所弒，遣兵部尚書侯君集率師安撫之，仍封順光子諾曷缽為河源郡王，使統其眾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Murong Shun, Prince of Xiping Commandery of the Tuyuhun, was assassinated by his subordinates; Minister of War Hou Junji was sent with troops to pacify them, and Shun's son Nuohebo was still enfeoffed as Prince of Heyuan Commandery to rule the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the twelfth month Murong Shun, Tuyuhun Prince of Xiping, was murdered by his own men; Hou Junji marched to settle the tribes and enfeoffed Shun's son Nuohebo as Prince of Heyuan to rule them.

sentences.zh: 右光祿大夫、宋國公蕭瑀依舊特進，復令參預朝政。

translations.literal: Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Xiao Yu, Duke of Song State, was restored to his former rank of Special Guardian and again ordered to take part in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, Duke of Song and right grand master, was restored as Special Guardian and again admitted to deliberations of state.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十年十年春正月壬子，尚書左僕射房玄齡、侍中魏徵上梁、陳、齊、周、隋五代史，詔藏於秘閣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on renzi, Left Deputy Director of the Masters of Writing Fang Xuanling and Palace Attendant Wei Zheng presented the histories of Liang, Chen, Qi, Zhou, and Sui; an edict ordered them stored in the Secret Archive.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Zhenguan, on renzi of the first spring month, Fang Xuanling and Wei Zheng presented the histories of Liang, Chen, Qi, Zhou, and Sui; the emperor ordered them placed in the Secret Archive.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，徙封趙王元景為荊王，魯王元昌為漢王，鄭王元禮為徐王，徐王元嘉為韓王，荊王元則為彭王，滕王元懿為鄭王，吳王元軌為霍王，豳王元鳳為虢王，陳王元慶為道王，魏王靈夔為燕王，蜀王恪為吳王，越王泰為魏王，燕王祐為齊王，梁王愔為蜀王，郯王惲為蔣王，漢王貞為越王，申王慎為紀王。

translations.literal: On guichou, Prince of Zhao Yuanjing was moved to Prince of Jing; Prince of Lu Yuanchang to Prince of Han; Prince of Zheng Yuanli to Prince of Xu; Prince of Xu Yuanjia to Prince of Han; Prince of Jing Yuanze to Prince of Peng; Prince of Teng Yuanyi to Prince of Zheng; Prince of Wu Yuan Gui to Prince of Huo; Prince of Bin Yuanfeng to Prince of Guo; Prince of Chen Yuanqing to Prince of Dao; Prince of Wei Lingquei to Prince of Yan; Prince of Shu Ke to Prince of Wu; Prince of Yue Tai to Prince of Wei; Prince of Yan You to Prince of Qi; Prince of Liang Yin to Prince of Shu; Prince of Tan Yun to Prince of Jiang; Prince of Han Zhen to Prince of Yue; Prince of Shen Zhen to Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou a great reshuffling of princely titles was decreed: among them Yuanjing of Zhao became Prince of Jing, Yuanchang of Lu became Prince of Han, Yuanli of Zheng became Prince of Xu, Yuanjia of Xu became Prince of Han, Yuanze of Jing became Prince of Peng, Yuanyi of Teng became Prince of Zheng, Yuan Gui of Wu became Prince of Huo, Yuanfeng of Bin became Prince of Guo, Yuanqing of Chen became Prince of Dao, Lingquei of Wei became Prince of Yan, Ke of Shu became Prince of Wu, Tai of Yue became Prince of Wei, You of Yan became Prince of Qi, Yin of Liang became Prince of Shu, Yun of Tan became Prince of Jiang, Zhen of Han became Prince of Yue, and Zhen of Shen became Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，以侍中魏徵為特進，仍知門下省事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Palace Attendant Wei Zheng was made Special Guardian and still directed the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month Wei Zheng was made Special Guardian while retaining charge of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，中書令溫彥博為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On renshen, Chief Director of the Secretariat Wen Yanbo became Right Deputy Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Chief Director Wen Yanbo became right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太常卿、安德郡公楊師道為侍中。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Director of Court Music and Duke of Ande Commandery Yang Shidao became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yang Shidao, director of court music and Duke of Ande, became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 己卯，皇后長孫氏崩於立政殿。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Empress of the Zhangsun clan died in Lize Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Empress Zhangsun died in Lize Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚寅，葬文德皇后於昭陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on gengyin, the Cultured Virtue Empress was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the eleventh winter month the Cultured Virtue Empress was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，吐谷渾河源郡王慕容諾曷缽來朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renshen, Nuohebo, Prince of Heyuan Commandery of the Tuyuhun, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the twelfth month Nuohebo, Tuyuhun Prince of Heyuan, came to court.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，親錄京師囚徒。

translations.literal: On yihai, the emperor personally reviewed prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he personally reviewed the capital's prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，關內、河東疾病，命醫賚藥療之。

translations.literal: That year disease struck Guanzhong and the east of the Yellow River; physicians were sent with medicine to treat the sick.
translations.idiomatic: That year plague ravaged Guanzhong and Hedong; the court sent physicians with medicine to treat the afflicted.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十一年十一年春正月丁亥朔，徙鄶王元裕為鄧王，譙王元名為舒王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on dinghai, the first day, Prince of Zheng Yuanli was moved to Prince of Deng and Prince of Qiao Yuanming to Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Zhenguan, on dinghai, the new-year's day of the first spring month, Yuanli of Zheng became Prince of Deng and Yuanming of Qiao became Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，加魏王泰為雍州牧、左武候大將軍。

translations.literal: On guisi, Prince of Wei Tai was additionally made Prefect of Yong Province and Left Martial Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince Tai of Wei was also made Yongzhou prefect and left martial guard general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，頒新律令於天下。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the new statutes and ordinances were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the new code and ordinances were promulgated empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 作飛山宮。

translations.literal: Feishan Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on Feishan Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，房玄齡等進所修《五禮》。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Fang Xuanling and others presented the Five Rites they had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Fang Xuanling and his colleagues presented the compiled Five Rites.

sentences.zh: 詔所司行用之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to put them into practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ministries to put the rites into practice.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingsi, an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month he issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸洛陽宮，命祭漢文帝。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he visited Luoyang Palace and ordered sacrifice to Emperor Wen of Han.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he went to Luoyang Palace and ordered rites for Emperor Wen of Han.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, bingxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the first day of the third month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，車駕至洛陽。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the imperial carriage reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court arrived at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，改洛州為洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Luozhou was renamed Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Luozhou was renamed Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大蒐於廣城澤。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a great hunt was held at Guangcheng Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he held a great hunt at Guangcheng Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，還宮。

translations.literal: On guichou, the court returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，震乾元殿前槐樹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, the locust tree before Qianyuan Hall was struck by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the fourth summer month lightning struck the locust tree before Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔河北、淮南舉孝悌淳篤，兼閑時務；

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered Hebei and Huainan to recommend men of filial piety and pure conduct who were also versed in current affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he decreed that Hebei and Huainan recommend men of filial piety and honest character who also understood public affairs;

sentences.zh: 儒術該通，可為師範；

translations.literal: those thoroughly versed in Confucian learning, fit to serve as models;
translations.idiomatic: scholars masterful in the classics, fit to be teachers;

sentences.zh: 文辭秀美，才堪著述；

translations.literal: those of elegant literary style, with talent for composition;
translations.idiomatic: writers of elegant style with talent for composition;

sentences.zh: 明識政體，可委字人：並志行修立，為鄉閭所推者，給傳詣洛陽宮。

translations.literal: and those of clear insight into government, fit to be entrusted with office: all whose conduct was cultivated and whom their districts commended—such men were to be given travel passes and sent to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: and men of clear political judgment fit for office—all of cultivated conduct commended in their home districts were to receive travel passes and come to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，尚書右僕射、虞國公溫彥博薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiayin, Right Deputy Director of the Masters of Writing Wen Yanbo, Duke of Yu State, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the sixth month Wen Yanbo, right vice director and Duke of Yu, died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸明德宮。

translations.literal: On dingsi, he visited Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he visited Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，定制諸王為世封刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, regulations were fixed making princes hereditary prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he fixed the rule that princes should hold prefectures in perpetual succession.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，定制勛臣為世封刺史。

translations.literal: On wuchen, regulations were fixed making meritorious officials hereditary prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he fixed the rule that meritorious ministers should likewise hold hereditary prefectures.

sentences.zh: 改封任城王道宗為江夏郡王，趙郡王孝恭為河間郡王。

translations.literal: Prince Daizong of Rencheng was moved to Prince of Jiangxia Commandery; Prince Xiaogong of Zhao Commandery to Prince of Hejian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Daizong of Rencheng was retitled Prince of Jiangxia; Prince Xiaogong of Zhao Commandery became Prince of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 己巳，改封許王元祥為江王。

translations.literal: On jisi, Prince of Xu Yuanxiang was moved to Prince of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Prince Yuanxiang of Xu became Prince of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，大霪雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei, there was torrential rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the seventh autumn month torrential rains fell.

sentences.zh: 谷水溢入洛陽宮，深四尺，壞左掖門，毀宮寺十九所；

translations.literal: The Gu River overflowed into Luoyang Palace to a depth of four feet, destroying the Left Flank Gate and ruining nineteen palace temples;
translations.idiomatic: The Gu River burst into Luoyang Palace four feet deep, wrecked the Left Flank Gate, and destroyed nineteen palace temples;

sentences.zh: 洛水溢，漂六百家。

translations.literal: the Luo River overflowed and swept away six hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: the Luo overflowed and swept away six hundred households.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔以災命百官上封事，極言得失。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict, because of the disaster, ordered all officials to submit sealed memorials speaking frankly of gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, citing the floods, he ordered every official to submit sealed memorials on what the court was doing right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，廢明德宮及飛山宮之玄圃院，分給遭水之家，仍賜帛有差。

translations.literal: On renyin, Mingde Palace and the Mystic Park of Feishan Palace were abolished; the grounds were divided among flood victims, and graded gifts of silk were also bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Mingde Palace and the Mystic Park at Feishan were dismantled; the land was given to flood victims and graded gifts of silk were distributed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，修老君廟於亳州，宣尼廟於兗州，各給二十戶享祀焉。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Laozi temple at Bozhou and the temple of Confucius at Yanzhou were repaired, each granted twenty households for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu temples to Laozi at Bozhou and to Confucius at Yanzhou were restored, each endowed with twenty service households.

sentences.zh: 涼武昭王復近墓二十戶充守衛，仍禁芻牧樵採。

translations.literal: Near the tomb of Li Gao, Martial King of Liang, twenty households were again assigned as guards, and grazing, fodder-cutting, and firewood-gathering were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty households were again posted to guard the tomb of Li Gao, Martial King of Liang, and grazing and woodcutting near the mound were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai;
translations.idiomatic: That ninth month, on dinghai—

sentences.zh: 河溢，壞陜州河北縣，毀河陽中潭。

translations.literal: the Yellow River overflowed, destroying Hebei County in Shan Prefecture and ruining the pools at Heyang Center;
translations.idiomatic: the Yellow River burst its banks, destroyed Hebei County in Shan Prefecture, and wrecked the pools at Heyang;

sentences.zh: 幸白司馬阪以觀之，賜遭水之家粟帛有差。

translations.literal: the emperor visited White Sima Slope to view the damage and bestowed graded gifts of grain and silk on flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: he went to White Sima Slope to see the damage and gave graded grain and silk to the stricken.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛卯，幸懷州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinmao, he visited Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the eleventh winter month he visited Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，狩於濟源。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he hunted at Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he hunted at Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，百濟王遣其太子隆來朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the king of Baekje sent his crown prince Yong to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the twelfth month the king of Baekje sent Crown Prince Yong to court.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十二年十二年春正月乙未，吏部尚書高士廉等上《氏族志》一百三十卷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhenguan, in the spring of the first month, on yiwei, Minister of Personnel Gao Shilian and others presented the Genealogical Record in one hundred thirty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Zhenguan, on yiwei of the first spring month, Gao Shilian, minister of personnel, and others presented the Genealogical Record in one hundred thirty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，松、叢二州地震，壞人廬舍，有壓死者。

translations.literal: On renyin, Song and Cong prefectures were shaken by earthquake; dwellings were destroyed and some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin earthquakes struck Song and Cong prefectures, wrecking houses and killing some inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，車駕還京。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，觀砥柱，勒銘以紀功德。

translations.literal: On guihai, he viewed the Pillars and had an inscription cut in stone to record his merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he viewed the River Pillars and had a stele cut to record his deeds.

sentences.zh: 甲子，夜郎獠反，夔州都督齊善行討平之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Yelang Liao rebelled; Protector of Kuizhou Qi Shixing suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Yelang Liao rose; Qi Shixing, protector of Kuizhou, crushed the revolt.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，次陜州，自新橋幸河北縣，祀夏禹廟。

translations.literal: On yichou, he halted at Shan Prefecture, went from Xinqiao to Hebei County, and sacrificed at the temple of Yu of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he stopped at Shan Prefecture, went from Xinqiao to Hebei County, and sacrificed at the temple of Yu the Great.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次柳谷頓，觀鹽池。

translations.literal: On dingmao, he halted at Liugu Station and viewed the salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he halted at Liugu Station and inspected the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以隋鷹揚郎將堯君素忠於本朝，贈蒲州刺史，仍錄其子孫。

translations.literal: On wuyin, because Sui Eagle-Flying General Yao Junsu had been loyal to his dynasty, he was posthumously made Prefect of Pu Prefecture and his descendants were recorded for office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Yao Junsu, a Sui eagle-flying general who had died loyal to the Sui, was posthumously made prefect of Pu and his descendants enrolled for office.

sentences.zh: 閏二月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary second month, gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the first day of the intercalary second month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he returned from Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he returned from Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬申，銀青光祿大夫、永興縣公虞世南卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renshen, Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yu Shinan, Duke of Yongxing County, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the fifth summer month Yu Shinan, silver-gleaming grand master and Duke of Yongxing, died.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，初置玄武門左右飛騎。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi, the left and right Flying Cavalry of the Xuanwu Gate were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the sixth month the left and right Flying Cavalry of the Xuanwu Gate were first established.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，吏部尚書、申國公高士廉為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, Minister of Personnel Gao Shilian, Duke of Shen State, became Right Deputy Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the seventh autumn month Gao Shilian, minister of personnel and Duke of Shen, became right vice director.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，狩於始平，賜高年粟帛有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, he hunted at Shiping and bestowed graded gifts of grain and silk on the aged.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the tenth winter month he hunted at Shiping and gave graded grain and silk to the elderly.

sentences.zh: 乙未，至自始平。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he returned from Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he returned from Shiping.

sentences.zh: 己亥，百濟遣使貢金甲雕斧。

translations.literal: On jihai, Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute of golden armor and carved axes.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Baekje sent envoys with tribute of golden armor and carved axes.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，右武候將軍上官懷仁大破山獠於壁州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, Right Martial Guard General Shangguan Huairen inflicted a great defeat on the mountain Liao at Bi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the twelfth month Shangguan Huairen, right martial guard general, crushed the mountain Liao at Bi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十三年十三年春正月乙巳朔，謁獻陵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhenguan, on the first day of the first month, yisi, he visited Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Zhenguan, on yisi, the new-year's day, he visited Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 曲赦三原縣及行從大闢罪。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to Sanyuan County and to those accompanying him for capital offenses.
translations.idiomatic: He granted a partial amnesty to Sanyuan County and to those in his train on capital charges.

sentences.zh: 丁未，至自獻陵。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he returned from Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he returned from Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加房玄齡為太子少師。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Fang Xuanling was additionally made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Fang Xuanling was also made junior tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，停世襲刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingzi, hereditary prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the second month hereditary prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，有星孛于畢、昴。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yichou, a broom star appeared in the constellations Bi and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the third month a comet appeared in Bi and Mao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, he traveled to the Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on wuyin, the Emperor went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，阿史那結社爾犯御營，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiashen Ashina Jieshe'er attacked the imperial encampment and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Ashina Jieshe'er raided the imperial camp and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雲陽石燃者方丈，晝如灰，夜則有光，投草木於上則焚，歷年而止。

translations.literal: On renyin, combusting stone at Yunyang measured a square zhang; by day it was like ash, by night it gave light, and whatever grass or wood was cast upon it burned — lasting many years before it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a burning stone at Yunyang covered a square zhang: ash by day, luminous by night, and anything thrown on it caught fire — the wonder lasted years.

sentences.zh: 自去冬不雨至於五月。

translations.literal: From the previous winter no rain fell until the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Drought had persisted since the previous winter through the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，避正殿，令五品以上上封事，減膳罷役，分使賑恤，申理冤屈，乃雨。

translations.literal: On jiayin he avoided the main hall, ordered officials of the fifth rank and above to submit sealed memorials, reduced meals and halted corvée labor, dispatched envoys to relieve distress and review unjust cases — and then rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he left the main hall, called for sealed memorials from fifth-rank officials upward, cut court meals and corvée, sent relief missions and reviewed wrongful cases — and rain followed.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，封皇弟元嬰為滕王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen, his younger brother Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Teng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen, the Emperor's brother Li Yuan Ying was created Prince of Teng.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the first day of the eighth autumn month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the first day of the eighth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，立右武候大將軍、化州都督、懷化郡王李思摩為突厥可汗，率所部建牙於河北。

translations.literal: On gengchen Li Simo, Grand General of the Right Martial Guards, prefect of Huazhou and Prince of Huaihua, was installed as Turk qaghan and led his followers to pitch tents north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Simo, general of the Right Martial Guards and Prince of Huaihua, was made Turk qaghan and settled his people north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on jiashen, he returned from the Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiashen, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，侍中、安德郡公楊師道為中書令。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinhai, Yang Shidao, Palace Attendant and Duke of Ande, became Zhongshu Ling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the eleventh month Yang Shidao, Duke of Ande and Palace Attendant, became Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，吏部尚書、陳國公侯君集為交河道行軍大總管，帥師伐高昌。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, Hou Junji, Minister of Personnel and Duke of Chen, became campaign commander of the Jiaozhi Circuit and led troops to attack Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the twelfth month Hou Junji, Duke of Chen and Minister of Personnel, took command of the Jiaozhi campaign and marched against Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封皇子福為趙王。

translations.literal: On yihai the Prince Fu was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Prince Li Fu was created Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 壬午，巂州都督王志遠有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renwu Wang Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Xi Prefecture, was guilty of a crime and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wang Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Xi Prefecture, was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 詔於洛、相、幽、徐、齊、並、秦、蒲等州並置常平倉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered ever-normal granaries established simultaneously in the prefectures of Luo, Xiang, You, Xu, Qi, Bing, Qin, Pu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established ever-normal granaries in Luo, Xiang, You, Xu, Qi, Bing, Qin, Pu, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吐谷渾河源郡王慕容諾曷缽來逆女。

translations.literal: On jichou Murong Nuohebo, Prince of Heyuan in Tuyuhun, came to receive a bride.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Murong Nuohebo, Tuyuhun Prince of Heyuan, came to fetch his bride.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，狩於咸陽。

translations.literal: On renchen he hunted at Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Emperor hunted at Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滁州言：「野蠶食槲葉，成繭大如柰，其色綠，凡六千五百七十石。

translations.literal: That year Chuzhou reported: "Wild silkworms fed on oak leaves and spun cocoons as large as nai fruit, green in color, totaling six thousand five hundred seventy piculs.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chuzhou reported wild silkworms on oak leaves had spun green cocoons as large as nai fruit, totaling 6,570 piculs.

sentences.zh: 」高麗、新羅、西突厥、吐火羅、康國、安國、波斯、疏勒、于闐、焉耆、高昌、林邑、昆明及荒服蠻酋，相次遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: " Goguryeo, Silla, the Western Turks, Tukhara, Kang, An, Persia, Shule, Khotan, Yanqi, Gaochang, Linyi, Kunming, and tribal chiefs from the distant borderlands sent envoys in succession with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo, Silla, the Western Turks, Tukhara, Kang, An, Persia, Shule, Khotan, Yanqi, Gaochang, Linyi, Kunming, and distant tribal chiefs sent tribute missions in turn.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十四年十四年春正月庚子，初命有司讀時令。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, on gengzi of the first spring month, officials were first ordered to read the seasonal ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, on gengzi of the first spring month, the court first ordered officials to proclaim the seasonal ordinances.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸魏王泰宅。

translations.literal: On jiayin he visited the residence of Prince Wei Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he visited Prince Wei Li Tai's mansion.

sentences.zh: 赦雍州及長安獄大闢罪已下。

translations.literal: He pardoned those in Yongzhou and Chang'an prisons down from capital crimes excluding great felonies.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned all prisoners in Yongzhou and Chang'an below the grade of great felony.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，幸國子學，親釋奠，赦大理、萬年系囚，國子祭酒以下及學生高第精勤者加一級，賜帛有差。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingchou, he visited the Directorate of Education, personally offered the sacrifice, pardoned prisoners held by the Court of Judicial Review and Wannian county, promoted the libationer and below and diligent high-ranked students one grade, and granted cloth and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the second month he visited the Imperial University, led the sacrifice in person, freed prisoners of the Court of Review and Wannian, promoted outstanding students and the libationer one grade, and granted cloth and silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，左驍衛將軍、淮陽王道明送弘化公主歸於吐谷渾。

translations.literal: On gengchen Li Daoming, Left Cavalry Guards General and Prince of Huaiyang, escorted the Princess Honghua back to Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Daoming, Prince of Huaiyang and Left Cavalry Guards general, escorted Princess Honghua to Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On renwu he traveled to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On xinmao he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he came back from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔以梁皇侃、褚仲都，周熊安生、沈重，陳沈文阿、周弘正、張機，隋何妥、劉焯、劉炫等前代名儒，學徒多行其義，命求其後。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict named eminent Confucians of former dynasties — Huang Kan and Chu Zhongdu of Liang; Xiong Ansheng and Shen Chong of Zhou; Shen Wen'a, Zhou Hongzheng, and Zhang Ji of Chen; He Tuo, Liu Chao, and Liu Xuan of Sui — whose teachings many disciples still followed, and ordered their descendants sought out.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict honored former masters — Huang Kan and Chu Zhongdu of Liang, Xiong Ansheng and Shen Chong of Northern Zhou, Shen Wen'a, Zhou Hongzheng, and Zhang Ji of Chen, He Tuo, Liu Chao, and Liu Xuan of Sui — and commanded that their descendants be found and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，置寧朔大使，以護突厥。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuwu, the post of Ambassador for Pacifying the North was established to protect the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu, the court created the post of Pacifying-the-North ambassador to oversee the Turks.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戌，徙封燕王靈夔為魯王。

translations.literal: In the fifth summer month, on renxu, Prince Lingkai of Yan was moved to Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, Prince Lingkai of Yan was retitled Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 己丑，薛延陀遣使求婚。

translations.literal: On jichou the Xueyantuo sent envoys to request a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Xueyantuo sought a marriage alliance by envoy.

sentences.zh: 乙未，滁州野蠶成繭，凡收八千三百石。

translations.literal: On yiwei wild silkworms in Chuzhou produced cocoons totaling eight thousand three hundred piculs harvested.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Chuzhou reported another wild-silkworm harvest of 8,300 piculs of cocoons.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，新作襄城宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengwu, the new Xiangcheng Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu, work was completed on Xiangcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，交河道行軍大總管侯君集平高昌，以其地置西州。

translations.literal: On guisi Hou Junji, campaign commander of the Jiaozhi Circuit, pacified Gaochang and established Western Prefecture on its territory.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Hou Junji, Jiaozhi campaign commander, conquered Gaochang and created Western Prefecture on its lands.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，曲赦西州大闢罪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guimao, a partial pardon was granted for great felonies in Western Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, Western Prefecture received a partial amnesty for capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於西州置安西都護府。

translations.literal: On yimao the Anxi Protectorate was established at Western Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court established the Anxi Protectorate at Western Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，詔以贈司空、河間元王孝恭，贈陜東道大行臺尚書右僕射、鄖節公殷開山，贈民部尚書、渝襄公劉政會等配饗高祖廟庭。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on jimao, an edict ordered Li Xiaogong, posthumous Prince Yuan of Hejian and Minister of Works; Yin Kaishan, posthumous Duke of Yun and Right Vice Director of the Shandong Circuit Grand Secretariat; Liu Zhenghui, posthumous Duke of Yu and Minister of Revenue — and others — enshrined in Gaozu's temple courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jimao, an edict enshrined Li Xiaogong of Hejian, Yin Kaishan of Yun, Liu Zhenghui of Yu, and other founding ministers in Gaozu's temple.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，幸同州。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the intercalary month he traveled to Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the intercalary month he went to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，狩於堯山。

translations.literal: On jiachen he hunted at Yao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted on Mount Yao.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至自同州。

translations.literal: On gengxu he returned from Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he returned from Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，吐蕃遣使獻黃金器千斤以求婚。

translations.literal: On bingchen Tibet sent envoys presenting a thousand jin of gold vessels to seek a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tibet sent envoys with a thousand jin of gold vessels to negotiate a royal marriage.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子朔，日南至。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the first day of the eleventh month, the winter solstice arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the first day of the eleventh month, the sun reached its southern limit.

sentences.zh: 有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: He performed the suburban sacrifice at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: He offered the suburban rite at the Round Mound altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，交河道旋師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, the Jiaozhi Circuit army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, the Jiaozhi expedition returned.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書、陳國公侯君集執高昌王麴智盛，獻捷於觀德殿，行飲至之禮，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Hou Junji, Minister of Personnel and Duke of Chen, brought the King of Gaochang Qu Zhisheng captive, presented the victory at the Hall of Observing Virtue, performed the ritual of reception on return from campaign, and granted three days of public feasting.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Junji, Duke of Chen, presented the captive King Qu Zhisheng of Gaochang at the Hall of Observing Virtue, held the victory feast, and granted three days of public revelry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗世子相權來朝。

translations.literal: On yimao the Goguryeo crown prince Sanggwon came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Goguryeo crown prince came to court.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十五年十五年春正月丁卯，吐蕃遣其國相祿東贊來逆女。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan, on dingmao of the first spring month, Tibet sent its chancellor Gar Tongtsen to receive the bride.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan, on dingmao of the first spring month, Tibet sent Chancellor Gar Tongtsen to fetch the princess.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禮部尚書、江夏王道宗送文成公主歸吐蕃。

translations.literal: On dingchou Li Daozong, Minister of Rites and Prince of Jiangxia, escorted the Princess Wencheng to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Daozong, Prince of Jiangxia and Minister of Rites, escorted Princess Wencheng to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi he traveled to the Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he went to the Luoyang palace.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，幸襄城宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wushen, he traveled to the Xiangcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wushen, he went to Xiangcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，發襄城宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu he departed the Xiangcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he left Xiangcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，詔以來年二月有事泰山，所司詳定儀制。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on xinmao, an edict ordered the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai in the second month of the coming year, and the relevant offices to draft the ritual protocol in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinmao, an edict scheduled the feng and shan at Mount Tai for the second month of the coming year and ordered the rites office to draft the protocol.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，並州僧道及老人等抗表，以太原王業所因，明年登封已後，願時臨幸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen, monks, Daoists, and elders of Bing Prefecture submitted memorials stating that Taiyuan was where the imperial enterprise arose, and after the fengshan next year they hoped he would visit from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, Bingzhou monks, Daoists, and elders petitioned that Taiyuan had nurtured the royal enterprise and begged him to visit after next year's fengshan.

sentences.zh: 上於武成殿賜宴，因從容謂侍臣曰：「朕少在太原，喜群聚博戲，暑往寒逝，將三十年矣。

translations.literal: At the Wucheng Hall he gave a banquet and, at ease, said to his attending ministers: "In my youth at Taiyuan I loved gathering for games of chance; summers passed and winters came — nearly thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: At Wucheng Hall he feasted his ministers and said lightly: "In my youth at Taiyuan I loved gathering for dice and wagers — nearly thirty summers and winters have passed.

sentences.zh: 」時會中有舊識上者，相與道舊以為笑樂。

translations.literal: " Among those present were some who had known him of old; they recounted old times together for laughter and pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Some old acquaintances were present; they traded reminiscences and laughter.

sentences.zh: 因謂之曰：』他人之言，或有面諛。

translations.literal: He then said to them: "Others may speak with flattery to one's face.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Strangers may flatter me to my face,

sentences.zh: 公等朕之故人，實以告朕，即日政教，於百姓何如？

translations.literal: You are my old friends — tell me in truth: how is government and instruction today for the common people?
translations.idiomatic: but you are my old companions — speak plainly: how fares governance for the people today?

sentences.zh: 人間得無疾苦耶？

translations.literal: Are there no hardships among the people?"
translations.idiomatic: Are the people free of hardship?"

sentences.zh: 」皆奏：「即日四海太平，百姓歡樂，陛下力也。

translations.literal: They all replied: "At present the four seas are at peace and the people rejoice — this is Your Majesty's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: They answered: "The realm is at peace and the people rejoice — all through Your Majesty's virtue.

sentences.zh: 臣等餘年，日惜一日，但眷戀聖化，不知疾苦。

translations.literal: We in our remaining years cherish each day under your sage rule and know no hardship."
translations.idiomatic: We in our old age savor each day of your rule and scarcely know want."

sentences.zh: 」因固請過並州。

translations.literal: They therefore urgently petitioned that he pass through Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They then pressed him to visit Bingzhou on his way.

sentences.zh: 上謂曰：「飛鳥過故鄉，猶躑躅徘徊；

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Even a bird passing its old nest hesitates and circles;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "Even a bird over its old nest hesitates and wheels about;

sentences.zh: 況朕於太原起義，遂定天下，復少小游觀，誠所不忘。

translations.literal: how much more I, who rose in arms at Taiyuan and secured the realm, and roamed there in youth — truly I cannot forget it.
translations.idiomatic: how much more I, who raised arms at Taiyuan and won the realm, and wandered there as a youth — I cannot forget it.

sentences.zh: 岱禮若畢，或冀與公等相見。

translations.literal: When the Mount Tai rites are complete, perhaps I may hope to meet you again."
translations.idiomatic: When the Tai rites are done, perhaps we may meet again."

sentences.zh: 」於是賜物各有差。

translations.literal: He then granted gifts to each in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: He then gave each man gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，百濟王扶餘璋卒。

translations.literal: On bingzi King Buyeo Jang of Baekje died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi King Jang of Baekje died.

sentences.zh: 詔立其世子扶餘義慈嗣其父位，仍封為帶方郡王。

translations.literal: An edict installed his heir Buyeo Yichi to succeed his father's position and enfeoffed him as Prince of Daifang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enthroned his heir Buyeo Yichi and created him Prince of Daifang.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，詔天下諸州，舉學綜古今及孝悌淳篤、文章秀異者，並以來年二月總集泰山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wushen, an edict ordered all prefectures to recommend men learned in ancient and modern texts, filial and pure in conduct, or outstanding in literary composition, all to assemble at Mount Tai in the second month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the sixth month an edict called on every prefecture to nominate scholars versed in the classics, men of filial purity, and gifted writers to gather at Mount Tai the following second month.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有星孛於太微，犯郎位。

translations.literal: On jiyou a broom star appeared in Taiwei and trespassed on the Courtiers' quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou a comet appeared in Taiwei and crossed the Courtiers' Belt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，停封泰山，避正殿以思咎，命食減膳。

translations.literal: On bingchen the fengshan at Mount Tai was halted; he avoided the main hall to reflect on faults and ordered reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Mount Tai fengshan was canceled; he left the main hall to ponder his faults and ordered leaner meals.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，孛星滅。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on jiaxu, the broom star vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiaxu, the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，大閱於伊闕。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on xinmao, he held a great review at Yique.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinmao, he held a grand review at Yique.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸嵩陽。

translations.literal: On renchen he traveled to Songyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he went to Songyang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，還宮。

translations.literal: On xinchou he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he went back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，廢鄉長。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renxu, village heads were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu, the office of village head was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，還京師。

translations.literal: On renshen he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，薛延陀以同羅、僕骨、回紇、靺鞨、霫之眾度漠，屯於白道川。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Xueyantuo led the peoples of Tongluo, Pugu, Huihe, Mohe, and Xi across the desert and encamped on the White Road River.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Xueyantuo crossed the desert with Tongluo, Pugu, Huihe, Mohe, and Xi forces and camped on the White Road River.

sentences.zh: 命營州都督張儉統所部兵壓其東境；
