translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Zhang Jian, military commissioner of Ying Prefecture, to command his troops to press their eastern border;
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Zhang Jian, commissioner of Yingzhou, to press them from the east;

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李勣為朔方行軍總管，右衛大將軍李大亮為靈州道行軍總管，涼州都督李襲譽為涼州道行軍總管，分道以御之。

translations.literal: Li Ji, Minister of War, became campaign commander of Shuofang; Li Daliang, Right Guard General, became campaign commander of the Lingzhou Circuit; Li Xiyu, military commissioner of Liang Prefecture, became campaign commander of the Liangzhou Circuit — each route to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ji became Shuofang campaign commander, Li Daliang commander on the Lingzhou route, and Li Xiyu commander on the Liangzhou route — each to meet them on a separate front.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子朔，至自洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the first day of the twelfth month, he returned from the Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the first day of the twelfth month, he returned from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李勣及薛延陀戰於諾真水，大破之，斬首三千餘級，獲馬萬五千匹，薛延陀跳身而遁。

translations.literal: On jiachen Li Ji fought the Xueyantuo at the Nuozhen River, routed them greatly, took more than three thousand heads, captured fifteen thousand horses, and the Xueyantuo leader fled by leaping away.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Ji met the Xueyantuo at the Nuozhen River, crushed them, took more than three thousand heads and fifteen thousand horses, and their leader bolted away.

sentences.zh: 勣旋破突厥思結於五臺縣，虜其男女千餘口，獲羊馬稱是。

translations.literal: Ji then smashed the Turkic Sigu clan at Wutai County, captured more than a thousand men and women, and seized sheep and horses in corresponding numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Ji then defeated the Turkic Sigu at Wutai, took more than a thousand captives, and seized flocks and herds in proportion.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十六年十六年春正月辛未，詔在京及諸州死罪囚徒，配西州為戶；

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhenguan, on xinwei of the first spring month, an edict ordered convicts sentenced to death in the capital and prefectures to be registered as households in Western Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Zhenguan, on xinwei of the first spring month, an edict sent capital and provincial death-row convicts to Western Prefecture as colonists;

sentences.zh: 流人未達前所者，徙防西州。

translations.literal: those in exile who had not yet reached their assigned place were transferred to garrison Western Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: exiles who had not yet reached their destination were reassigned to guard Western Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 兼中書侍郎、江陵子岑文本為中書侍郎，專知機密。

translations.literal: Cen Wenben, Concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat and Viscount of Jiangling, became Vice Director of the Secretariat with exclusive charge of confidential matters.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Wenben, Viscount of Jiangling, became Secretariat vice director with sole charge of confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛卯，詔復隱王建成曰隱太子，改封海陵剌王元吉曰巢剌主。

translations.literal: In the sixth summer month, on xinmao, an edict restored Prince Jian the Hidden to posthumous title Hidden Crown Prince and changed Prince of Hailing, the Assassin Prince Yuanji, to Assassin Prince of Chao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, an edict restored Li Jiancheng as Hidden Crown Prince and retitled the assassin Li Yuanji as Prince of Chao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，司空、趙國公無忌為司徒，尚書左僕射、梁國公玄齡為司空。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on wuwu, Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao and Minister of Works, became Minister of Education; Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuwu, Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao, became Minister of Education, and Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，特進、鄭國公魏徵為太子太師，知門下省事如故。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi, Wei Zheng, Special Grand Master and Duke of Zheng, became Grand Tutor to the crown prince while retaining charge of Palace Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingsi, Wei Zheng, Duke of Zheng, became grand tutor to the heir while continuing to oversee Palace Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙辰，狩於岐山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh winter month, on bingchen, he hunted at Mount Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, he hunted on Mount Qi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，使祭隋文帝陵。

translations.literal: On xinyou he sent envoys to sacrifice at Sui Wendi's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he sent envoys to offer sacrifice at Sui Wendi's tomb.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宴武功士女於慶善宮南門。

translations.literal: On dingmao he feasted the men and women of Wugong at the south gate of the Qingshan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he feasted the elders and townsfolk of Wugong at the south gate of Qingshan Palace.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，上與父老等涕泣論舊事，老人等遞起為舞，爭上萬歲壽，上各盡一杯。

translations.literal: When the wine was deep, the Emperor and the elders wept as they spoke of old affairs; the elders rose in turn to dance, vied to offer long life, and the Emperor drained a cup with each.
translations.idiomatic: As the wine warmed, he and the elders wept over old times; they rose in turn to dance, shouted long life, and he drained a cup with each.

sentences.zh: 庚午，至自岐州。

translations.literal: On gengwu he returned from Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he returned from Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao, he traveled to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao, he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，狩於驪山，時陰寒晦冥，圍兵斷絕。

translations.literal: On jiachen he hunted at Mount Li; the weather was cold, dark, and murky, and the encircling troops lost contact.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted on Mount Li in cold, murky weather, and the beaters lost contact.

sentences.zh: 上乘高望見之，欲舍其罰，恐虧軍令，乃回轡入谷以避之。

translations.literal: Riding high he saw them; he wished to waive their punishment but feared compromising military law, so he turned his bridle into a valley to avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: From a height he saw them stranded; he wanted to pardon them yet feared breaking discipline, so he turned into a ravine to spare them sight of him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗大臣蓋蘇文弒其君高武，而立武兄子藏為王。

translations.literal: That year the Goguryeo minister Yeon Gaesomun murdered his lord King Gao Wu and installed Wu's elder brother's son Jang as king.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Goguryeo minister Yeon Gaesomun killed King Yeongnyu and enthroned his nephew Jang.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十七年十七年春正月戊辰，右衛將軍、代州都督劉蘭謀反，腰斬。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Zhenguan, on wuchen of the first spring month, Liu Lan, Right Guard General and military commissioner of Dai Prefecture, plotted rebellion and was executed by waist bisection.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Zhenguan, on wuchen of the first spring month, Liu Lan, general of the Right Guards and commissioner of Daizhou, rebelled and was cut in two at the waist.

sentences.zh: 太子太師、鄭國公魏徵薨。

translations.literal: Wei Zheng, Grand Tutor to the crown prince and Duke of Zheng, died.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng, Duke of Zheng and grand tutor to the heir, died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔圖畫司徒、趙國公無忌等勛臣二十四人於凌煙閣。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict ordered portraits painted of Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of Education and Duke of Zhao, and twenty-three other meritorious officials in the Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict commissioned portraits of Zhangsun Wuji and twenty-three other meritorious ministers for the Lingyan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，齊州都督齊王祐殺長史權萬紀、典軍韋文振，據齊州自守，詔兵部尚書李勣、刑部尚書劉德威發兵討之。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the third month, Li You, Prince of Qi and military governor of Qizhou, killed Chief Administrator Quan Wanji and Army Inspector Wei Wenzhen, held Qizhou in defiance, and an edict ordered Li Jing, Minister of War, and Liu Dewei, Minister of Punishments, to raise troops and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the third month Prince of Qi Li You, governor of Qizhou, slew his chief administrator Quan Wanji and army inspector Wei Wenzhen and barricaded himself in the city; Li Jing, minister of war, and Liu Dewei, minister of punishments, were ordered to march against him.

sentences.zh: 兵未至，兵曹杜行敏執之而降，遂賜死於內侍省。

translations.literal: Before the army arrived, Du Xingmin of the military staff seized him and surrendered; he was then ordered to take his own life in the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: The troops had not yet arrived when Du Xingmin of the military staff seized the prince and surrendered him; he was then granted death in the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，熒惑守心前星，十九日而退。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Mars held station before the Fore Star for nineteen days before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Mars lingered before the Fore Star for nineteen days before passing on.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，皇太子有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth summer month, gengchen, the Crown Prince was found guilty and deposed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the new moon of the fourth summer month, the crown prince was judged guilty and cast down to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 漢王元昌、吏部尚書侯君集並坐與連謀，伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince of Han Yuan Chang and Minister of the Civil Office Hou Junji were both implicated in the conspiracy and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Han Yuan Chang and Hou Junji, minister of the civil office, were both condemned as accomplices and put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，立晉王治為皇太子，大赦，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince Jin Zhi was established as Crown Prince; a general amnesty was proclaimed and celebratory feasts granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Prince Jin Li Zhi was made crown prince; he proclaimed a general amnesty and granted three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中書令楊師道為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Chief Councillor Yang Shidao was appointed Minister of the Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yang Shidao, chief councillor, was made minister of the civil office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，加司徒、趙國公長孫無忌太子太師，司空、梁國公房玄齡太子太傅；

translations.literal: On jichou, the title of Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince was added to Grand Mentor Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao, Grand Tutor to Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao and grand mentor, was made grand preceptor of the crown prince; Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang and grand tutor,

sentences.zh: 特進、宋國公蕭瑀太子太保，兵部尚書、英國公李勣為太子詹事，仍同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Special Emeritus Xiao Yu, Duke of Song, as Grand Protector; Li Jing, Duke of Ying, Minister of War, as Steward of the Heir Apparent, continuing as Associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: was joined by Xiao Yu, Duke of Song, as grand protector; and Li Jing, Duke of Ying and minister of war, as steward of the heir apparent, still serving as associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上親謁太廟，以謝承乾之過。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Emperor personally visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple to atone for Chengqian's offenses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor went in person to the ancestral temple to answer for Chengqian's crimes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，魏王泰以罪降爵為東萊郡王。

translations.literal: On guisi, Prince of Wei Tai was demoted for his crimes to Duke of Donglai.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince of Wei Li Tai was stripped of rank for his crimes and made Duke of Donglai.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，手詔舉孝廉茂才異能之士。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou, by imperial autograph he summoned filial, eminent, and exceptionally talented men.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the fifth month he issued a personal edict calling up men of filial virtue, eminent talent, and exceptional ability.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, jimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the new moon of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改葬隋恭帝。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Sui Emperor Gong was reburied.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Sui emperor Gong was given a new burial.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，尚書右僕射高士廉請致仕，詔以為開府儀同三司、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Vice Director of the Chancellery Gao Shilian requested retirement; he was appointed Director with honors equal to the Third Rank at the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gao Shilian, vice director of the chancellery, asked to retire and was made director with the honorary rank of third grade at the secretariat and chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊午，薛延陀遣其兄子突利設獻馬五萬匹、牛駝一萬、羊十萬以請婚，許之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuwu, Xueyantuo sent his elder brother's son Tulishe with fifty thousand horses, ten thousand oxen and camels, and one hundred thousand sheep to request a marriage alliance; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the intercalary month Xueyantuo sent the qaghan's nephew Tulishe with fifty thousand horses, ten thousand oxen and camels, and a hundred thousand sheep to sue for a marriage alliance, which was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，徙封東萊郡王泰為順陽王。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Prince of Donglai Tai was transferred to Duke of Shunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Duke of Donglai Li Tai was transferred to Duke of Shunyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，京城訛言云：「上遣棖棖取人心肝，以祠天狗。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on gengchen, wild rumors in the capital said: "The Emperor has sent his heart-snatchers to take people's hearts and livers to sacrifice to the Heavenly Dog.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the seventh autumn month a wild rumor ran through Chang'an: "The emperor has sent his heart-snatchers to cut out men's hearts and livers as offerings to the Heavenly Dog.

sentences.zh: 」遞相驚悚。

translations.literal: " Alarm spread from person to person.
translations.idiomatic: " Panic passed from mouth to mouth.

sentences.zh: 上遣使遍加宣諭，月餘乃止。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent emissaries to proclaim reassurance throughout; only after more than a month did it cease.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to reassure the people everywhere; more than a month passed before the uproar died away.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，司空、太子太傅、梁國公房玄齡以母憂罷職。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang and grand tutor of the heir apparent, left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 八月，工部尚書、鄖國公張亮為刑部尚書，參預朝政。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Zhang Liang, Duke of Zhen, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Punishments and joined in deliberating on government.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Liang, Duke of Zhen and minister of works, became minister of punishments and took a seat in court deliberations.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，徙庶人承乾於黔州。

translations.literal: On guawei of the ninth month, the deposed Chengqian was relocated to Qian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guawei of the ninth month the deposed Chengqian was sent into exile at Qian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，房玄齡起復本職。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on dingsi, Fang Xuanling returned from mourning to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the tenth winter month Fang Xuanling returned from mourning to his former post.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: On jimao of the eleventh month, the southern suburban sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the eleventh month he performed the southern suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜天下酺三日。

translations.literal: On rewu, celebratory feasts were granted throughout the realm for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On rewu he granted three days of public feasting throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以涼州獲瑞石，曲赦涼州，並錄京城及諸州系囚，多所原宥。

translations.literal: Because an auspicious stone was obtained in Liangzhou, a partial amnesty was granted there; prisoners in the capital and in all prefectures were reviewed, and many were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: When an auspicious stone was found in Liangzhou he granted a partial amnesty there and reviewed prisoners in the capital and in every prefecture, pardoning many.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十八年十八年春正月壬寅，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighteenth year of Zhenguan, on renyin of the first month, he went to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Zhenguan, on renyin of the first spring month, he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on xinhai, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the fourth summer month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eighth autumn month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth autumn month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，散騎常侍清苑男劉洎為侍中，中書侍郎江陵子岑文本、中書侍郎馬周並為中書令。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Palace Attendant Liu Ji was made Attending Secretary; Vice Directors of the Secretariat Cen Wuben and Ma Zhou were both made Secretaries of State.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liu Ji, palace attendant and Baron of Qingyuan, was made attending secretary; Cen Wuben and Ma Zhou, vice directors of the secretariat, were both made secretaries of state.

sentences.zh: 九月，黃門侍郎褚遂良參預朝政。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Vice Director of the Gate Huangmen Chu Suiliang joined in deliberating on government.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chu Suiliang, vice director of the yellow gate, joined in court deliberations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On xinchou, first day of the tenth winter month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the new moon of the tenth winter month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，初置太子司議郎官員。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the office of Admonisher of the Heir Apparent was established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the office of admonisher of the heir apparent was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he proceeded to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 安西都護郭孝恪帥師滅焉耆，執其王突騎支送行在所。

translations.literal: Protector-General of the Pacified West Guo Xiaoke led troops and destroyed Yanqi, seized its king Tutuizhi, and sent him to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiaoke, protector-general of the pacified west, led an army that destroyed Yanqi, seized King Tutuizhi, and sent him to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，車駕至洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eleventh month, the imperial carriage reached Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the eleventh month the imperial carriage reached Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命太子詹事、英國公李勣為遼東道行軍總管，出柳城，禮部尚書、江夏郡王道宗副之；

translations.literal: On gengzi, Steward Li Jing, Duke of Ying, was appointed campaign commander on the Liaodong circuit, setting out from Liucheng, with Minister of Rites Prince Daozong of Jiangxia as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Jing, Duke of Ying and steward of the heir apparent, was made campaign commander on the Liaodong circuit, marching from Liucheng, with Prince Daozong of Jiangxia, minister of rites, as his deputy;

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書、鄖國公張亮為平壤道行軍總管，以舟師出萊州，左領軍常何、瀘州都督左難當副之。

translations.literal: Zhang Liang, Duke of Zhen, Minister of Punishments, was commander on the Pyongyang circuit with naval forces out of Laizhou, with Left Army General Chang He and Military Governor of Luzhou Zuo Nandang as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhang Liang, Duke of Zhen and minister of punishments, commander on the Pyongyang circuit with a fleet out of Laizhou, with Chang He of the left army and Zuo Nandang, governor of Luzhou, as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 發天下甲士，召募十萬，並趣平壤，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: Armored men were mobilized throughout the realm; one hundred thousand were recruited, all converging on Pyongyang to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Armored men were levied throughout the realm and a hundred thousand recruits were raised, all hurrying to Pyongyang for the campaign against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，庶人承乾死。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the twelfth month, the deposed Chengqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the twelfth month the deposed Chengqian died.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十九年十九年春二月庚戌，上親統六軍發洛陽。

translations.literal: In spring of the nineteenth year of Zhenguan, on gengxu of the second month, the Emperor personally led the Six Armies and set out from Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Zhenguan, on gengxu of the second spring month, the emperor personally led the Six Armies out of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔皇太子留定州監國；

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered the Crown Prince to remain at Dingzhou to oversee the realm;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he decreed that the crown prince remain at Dingzhou to oversee the realm;

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司、申國公高士廉攝太子太傅，與侍中劉洎、中書令馬周、太子少詹事張行成、太子右庶子高季輔五人同掌機務；

translations.literal: Gao Shilian, Duke of Shen, acting Grand Tutor, with Attending Secretary Liu Ji, Secretary Ma Zhou, Junior Steward Zhang Xingcheng, and Right Assistant to the Heir Gao Jifu — five men jointly handled state affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shilian, Duke of Shen, acting grand tutor, with Liu Ji, Ma Zhou, Zhang Xingcheng, and Gao Jifu — five men in all — were to handle state affairs together;

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書、安德郡公楊師道為中書令。

translations.literal: Yang Shidao, Duke of Ande, Minister of the Civil Office, was made Secretary of State.
translations.idiomatic: and Yang Shidao, Duke of Ande and minister of the civil office, was made secretary of state.

sentences.zh: 贈殷比干為太師，謚曰忠烈，命所司封墓，葺祠堂，春秋祠以少牢，上自為文以祭之。

translations.literal: Bi Gan of Yin was posthumously made Grand Tutor with the posthumous name Loyal and Stern; authorities were ordered to seal his tomb, repair his shrine, sacrifice with lesser victim each spring and autumn; the Emperor himself composed a text and offered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Gan of Yin was posthumously made grand tutor with the posthumous name Loyal and Stern; the authorities were ordered to seal his tomb, repair his shrine, and sacrifice each spring and autumn with the lesser victim; the emperor himself composed a text and offered sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，上發定州，以司徒、太子太師兼檢校侍中、趙國公長孫無忌，中書令岑文本、楊師道從。

translations.literal: On renchen of the third month, he set out from Dingzhou with Zhangsun Wuji, Grand Preceptor and Examining Attending Secretary, and Secretaries Cen Wuben and Yang Shidao in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the third month he marched from Dingzhou with Zhangsun Wuji, grand preceptor and examining attending secretary, and the secretaries Cen Wuben and Yang Shidao in his train.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，誓師於幽州城南，因大饗六軍以遣之。

translations.literal: On guimao of the fourth summer month, he took the army oath south of Youzhou city and thereupon feasted the Six Armies on a grand scale before sending them forth.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the fourth summer month he swore in the army south of Youzhou and thereupon feasted the Six Armies on a grand scale before sending them forth.

sentences.zh: 丁未，中書令岑文本卒於師。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Secretary Cen Wuben died with the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Cen Wuben, secretary of state, died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遼東道行軍大總管、英國公李勣攻蓋牟城，破之。

translations.literal: On guihai, Campaign Commander Li Jing attacked and took Gaimou city.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Jing, campaign commander, attacked and took Gaimou.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，車駕渡遼。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the fifth month, the imperial carriage crossed the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fifth month the imperial carriage crossed the Liao.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上親率鐵騎與李勣會圍遼東城，因烈風發火弩，斯須城上屋及樓皆盡，麾戰士令登，乃拔之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Emperor personally led iron cavalry to join Li Jing in investing Liaodong city; taking advantage of a violent wind he loosed fire-bolts, and in an instant buildings and towers on the walls were consumed; he commanded the warriors to climb, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor led his iron cavalry to join Li Jing in investing Liaodong; riding a fierce wind he loosed fire-bolts, and in a breath the towers and roofs on the wall were ash; he ordered the men up the ladders and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，師至安市城。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the sixth month, the army reached Anshi city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the sixth month the army reached Anshi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，高麗別將高延壽、高惠真帥兵十五萬來援安市，以拒王師。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Goguryeo lieutenant generals Gao Yanshou and Gao Huizhen led one hundred fifty thousand men to relieve Anshi and resist the royal army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Goguryeo generals Gao Yanshou and Gao Huizhen led a hundred and fifty thousand men to relieve Anshi and bar the imperial army.

sentences.zh: 李勣率兵奮擊，上自高峰引軍臨之，高麗大潰，殺獲不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Li Jing led troops in fierce attack; the Emperor brought his army down from the heights to press them; Goguryeo collapsed in rout; kills and captures were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing led a furious charge; the emperor brought his men down from the heights to press the enemy; Goguryeo broke and fled; the slain and captured were beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 延壽等以其眾降，因名所幸山為駐蹕山，刻石紀功焉。

translations.literal: Yanshou and the others surrendered with their forces; the mountain where the Emperor had lodged was therefore named Mount Imperial Sojourn, and stone was carved to record the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshou and his men surrendered with their host; the mountain where the emperor had halted was therefore named Mount Imperial Sojourn, and stone was carved to record the deed.

sentences.zh: 賜天下大酺二日。

translations.literal: Great celebratory feasts were granted throughout the realm for two days.
translations.idiomatic: He granted two days of public feasting throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，李勣進軍攻安市城，至九月不克，乃班師。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month Li Jing pressed the attack on Anshi city; by the ninth month it had not fallen, and the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Li Jing pressed the siege of Anshi; by the ninth month the city had not fallen, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，入臨渝關，皇太子自定州迎謁。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the tenth winter month, they entered Linyu Pass; the Crown Prince came from Dingzhou to welcome and pay homage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the tenth winter month the army entered Linyu Pass; the crown prince came from Dingzhou to welcome the emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次漢武臺，刻石以紀功德。

translations.literal: On wuwu, they halted at Hanwu Terrace and carved stone to record the merit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he halted at Hanwu Terrace and had stone carved to record his merit.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，幸幽州。

translations.literal: On xinwei of the eleventh month, he proceeded to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eleventh month he went to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大饗，還師。

translations.literal: On guiyou, a grand feast was held and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he held a grand feast and the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，幸並州。

translations.literal: On wushen of the twelfth month, he proceeded to Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the twelfth month he went to Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 侍中、清苑男劉洎以罪賜死。

translations.literal: Liu Ji, Attending Secretary and Baron of Qingyuan, was ordered to die for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, attending secretary and Baron of Qingyuan, was ordered to die for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，薛延陀真珠毗伽可汗死。

translations.literal: That year Zhenzhu Pijia Qaghan of Xueyantuo died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhenzhu Pijia, qaghan of Xueyantuo, died.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十年二十年春正月，上在並州。

translations.literal: In spring of the twentieth year of Zhenguan, the Emperor was at Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Zhenguan, in spring, the emperor was at Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣大理卿孫伏伽、黃門侍郎褚遂良等二十二人，以六條巡察四方，黜陟官吏。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Director of the Court of Judicature Sun Fuga and Vice Director of the Gate Chu Suiliang with twenty-two others were sent to inspect the four quarters under the Six Regulations, promoting and demoting officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Sun Fuga, director of the court of judicature, and Chu Suiliang, vice director of the yellow gate, with twenty-two others were sent to tour the four quarters under the Six Regulations and promote or demote officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，曲赦並州，宴從官及起義元從，賜粟帛、給復有差。

translations.literal: On gengchen, a partial amnesty for Bingzhou; he feasted the attending officials and the original founding followers, granting grain, silk, and tax exemptions in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he granted a partial amnesty to Bingzhou, feasted the officials in his train and the men who had risen with him at the founding, and gave graded gifts of grain, silk, and exemptions from corvée.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，車駕至京師。

translations.literal: On jisi of the third month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the third month the imperial carriage reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，刑部尚書、鄭國公張亮謀反，誅。

translations.literal: On jichou, Zhang Liang, Duke of Zheng, Minister of Punishments, plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhang Liang, Duke of Zheng and minister of punishments, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guisi, first day of the intercalary month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the new moon of the intercalary month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，太子太師、趙國公長孫無忌，太子太傅、梁國公房玄齡，太子太保、宋國公蕭瑀各辭調護之職，詔許之。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the fourth summer month, Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, and Xiao Yu each resigned their posts as tutors and protectors of the heir apparent; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the fourth summer month Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, and Xiao Yu each asked to be released from tutoring and protecting the heir apparent, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣兵部尚書、固安公崔敦禮，特進、英國公李勣擊破薛延陀於鬱督軍山北，前後斬首五千餘級，虜男女三萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Cui Dunli, Duke of Gu'an, Minister of War, and Li Jing, Duke of Ying, Special Emeritus, were sent and defeated Xueyantuo north of Mount Yudujun; in all more than five thousand heads were taken before and after, and men and women captives numbering more than thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Cui Dunli, Duke of Gu'an and minister of war, and Li Jing, Duke of Ying and special emeritus, were sent and broke Xueyantuo north of Mount Yudujun, taking more than five thousand heads in all and more than thirty thousand men and women captive.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，封皇孫為陳王。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eighth autumn month, an imperial grandson was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth autumn month an imperial grandson was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸靈州。

translations.literal: On jisi, he proceeded to Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he went to Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次涇陽頓。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he halted at the Jingyang encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he halted at the Jingyang encampment.

sentences.zh: 鐵勒回紇、拔野古、同羅、僕骨、多濫葛、思結、阿跌、契苾、跌結、渾、斛薛等十一姓各遣使朝貢，奏稱：「延陀可汗不事大國，部落烏散，不知所之。

translations.literal: Eleven tribes of the Tiele — Uighur, Bayegu, Tongluo, Pugu, Duolange, Sijie, Adie, Qibi, Diejie, Hun, and Husse — each sent envoys with tribute, memorializing: "The Yantuo qaghan does not serve the great state; his tribes have scattered like birds and none knows where they have gone.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Tiele tribes — the Uighur, Bayegu, Tongluo, Pugu, Duolange, Sijie, Adie, Qibi, Diejie, Hun, and Husse — each sent envoys with tribute, saying: "The Yantuo qaghan will not serve the great state; his tribes have scattered like birds and no one knows where they have gone.

sentences.zh: 奴等各有分地，不能逐延陀去，歸命天子，乞置漢官。

translations.literal: We each have our allotted lands and cannot follow the Yantuo away; we submit to the Son of Heaven and beg that Han officials be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: We each hold our own lands and cannot follow the Yantuo into exile; we submit to the Son of Heaven and beg that Han officials be set over us.

sentences.zh: 」詔遣會靈州。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered them to assemble at Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " He decreed that they assemble at Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，鐵勒諸部落俟斤、頡利發等遣使相繼而至靈州者數千人，來貢方物，因請置吏，咸請至尊為可汗。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the ninth month, thousands of envoys from the Tiele tribes — ilkins, eltebers, and the like — arrived in succession at Lingzhou, bearing regional products and requesting the appointment of officials; all asked that the Sovereign become qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the ninth month thousands of Tiele envoys — ilkins, eltebers, and the like — came in succession to Lingzhou with regional tribute, asked for the appointment of officials, and all begged that the sovereign be made qaghan.

sentences.zh: 於是北荒悉平，為五言詩勒石以序其事。

translations.literal: Thereupon the northern wilds were entirely pacified; he composed a pentasyllabic poem and carved it on stone to narrate the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The northern wilds were thereby pacified; he composed a pentasyllabic poem and had it carved on stone to tell the story.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，靈州地震有聲。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Lingzhou experienced an earthquake with audible sounds.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Lingzhou was shaken by an earthquake that could be heard.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，前太子太保、宋國公蕭瑀貶商州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, Xiao Yu, former Grand Protector, Duke of Song, was demoted to Prefect of Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Xiao Yu, former grand protector and Duke of Song, was demoted to prefect of Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自靈州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he returned from Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he returned from Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十一年二十一年春正月壬辰，開府儀同三司、申國公高士廉薨。

translations.literal: In spring of the twenty-first year of Zhenguan, on renchen of the first month, Gao Shilian, Duke of Shen, Director with honors, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Zhenguan, on renchen of the first spring month, Gao Shilian, Duke of Shen and director with honors, died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔以來年二月有事泰山。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict ordered that the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai be performed in the second month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he decreed that the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai be performed in the second month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜京師酺三日。

translations.literal: On jiayin, celebratory feasts were granted in the capital for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he granted three days of public feasting in the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，詔以左丘明、卜子夏、公羊高、穀梁赤、伏勝、高堂生、戴聖、毛萇、孔安國、劉向、鄭眾、杜子春、馬融、盧植、鄭康成、服子慎、何休、王肅、王輔嗣、杜元凱、範寧等二十一人，代用其書，垂於國胄，自今有事於太學，並命配享宣尼廟堂。

translations.literal: On renshen of the second month, an edict named twenty-one scholars — Zuoqiu Ming, Bu Zixia, Gongsun Gao, Guliang Chi, Fu Sheng, Master Gaotang, Dai Sheng, Mao Chang, Kong Anguo, Liu Xiang, Zheng Zhong, Du Zichun, Ma Rong, Lu Zhi, Zheng Xuan, Fu Qian, He Xiu, Wang Su, Wang Bi, Du Yu, and Fan Ning — their works to be used in place of originals, transmitted to the imperial academies; from now on at Grand Academy ceremonies all were ordered to share sacrificial honors in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the second month he decreed that twenty-one scholars — from Zuoqiu Ming to Fan Ning — should have their books used in the imperial academies in place of the old texts, and that from this time forward, whenever rites were performed at the Grand Academy, all were to share sacrificial honors in the temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇太子於國學釋菜。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Crown Prince performed the vegetable-offering rite at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the crown prince performed the vegetable-offering rite at the National University.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，營太和宮於終南之上，改為翠微宮。

translations.literal: On yichou of the fourth summer month, Taihe Palace was built on Mount Zhongnan; its name was changed to Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the fourth summer month Taihe Palace was built on Mount Zhongnan and renamed Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，幸翠微宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the fifth month, he proceeded to Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the fifth month he went to Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，司徒、趙國公無忌加授揚州都督。

translations.literal: On guihai of the sixth month, Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao, Grand Tutor, was additionally appointed military governor of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the sixth month Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao and grand tutor, was additionally made military governor of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，建玉華宮於宜君縣之鳳凰穀。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the seventh autumn month, Yuhua Palace was built in Phoenix Valley, Yijun county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the seventh autumn month Yuhua Palace was built in Phoenix Valley in Yijun county.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至自翠微宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he returned from Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he returned from Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，詔以河北大水，停封禪。

translations.literal: On renxu of the eighth month, an edict announced that because of great floods in Hebei, the fengshan ceremony was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he decreed that because of great floods in Hebei the fengshan ceremony was suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛未，骨利幹國遣使貢名馬。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the state of Guligan sent envoys presenting famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the state of Guligan sent envoys with famous horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，封皇子明為曹王。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Prince Ming was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Prince Ming was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸卯，徙封順陽王泰為濮王。

translations.literal: On guimao of the eleventh winter month, Prince of Shunyang Tai was transferred to Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eleventh winter month Prince of Shunyang Li Tai was transferred to Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，左驍衛大將軍阿史那社爾、右驍衛大將軍契苾何力、安西都護郭孝恪、司農卿楊弘禮為琯山道行軍大總管，以伐龜茲。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the twelfth month, Ashina She'er, Great General of the Left Valiant Guards, Qibi Heli, Great General of the Right Valiant Guards, Guo Xiaoke, Protector-General of the Pacified West, and Yang Hongli, Director of the Court of the Granary, were made commanders on the Guanshan circuit to attack Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the twelfth month Ashina She'er, great general of the left valiant guards, Qibi Heli, great general of the right valiant guards, Guo Xiaoke, protector-general of the pacified west, and Yang Hongli, director of the court of the granary, were made commanders on the Guanshan circuit to attack Kucha.

sentences.zh: 是歲，墮婆登、乙利、鼻林送、都播、羊同、石、波斯、康國、吐火羅、阿悉吉等遠夷十九國，並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, nineteen distant states — including Fallen Demon Ascension, Yili, Nose Forest Delivery, Dubo, Yangtong, the Shi state, Persia, Kang, Tocharistan, and Ashiji — all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year nineteen distant peoples — among them Jabung, Yili, Bilinsong, Dubo, Yangtong, Shi, Persia, Kang, Tocharistan, and Ashiji — all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 又於突厥之北至於回紇部落，置驛六十六所，以通北荒焉。

translations.literal: Moreover, from north of the Turks to the Huihe tribes, sixty-six relay stations were established to open communication with the northern wastes.
translations.idiomatic: He also set up sixty-six relay posts from the Turk lands northward to the Huihe tribes, opening the road into the northern wilds.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十二年二十二年春正月庚寅，中書令馬周卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Zhenguan, in the twenty-second year, spring, first month, on gengyin, Chief Councillor Ma Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Zhenguan, on gengyin of the first spring month, Chief Councillor Ma Zhou died.

sentences.zh: 司徒、趙國公無忌兼檢校中書令，知尚書門下二省事。

translations.literal: Minister of Education, Duke of Zhao Wuji was made concurrent Inspector-General of the Secretariat and managed the affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of Education and Duke of Zhao, was also named Inspector-General of the Secretariat and took charge of Secretariat and Chancellery business.

sentences.zh: 已亥，刑部侍郎崔仁師為中書侍郎，參知機務。

translations.literal: On jihai, Vice Minister of Justice Cui Renshi was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and participated in deliberations on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Cui Renshi, Vice Minister of Justice, became Vice Director of the Secretariat with a seat in confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On wuxu he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，還宮。

translations.literal: On wushen he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he came back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月，前黃門侍郎褚遂良起復黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second month, former Household Associate Attendant Chu Suiliang was recalled from mourning to his former post as Household Associate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Chu Suiliang, former Household Associate Attendant, left mourning and resumed that office.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎崔仁師除名，配流連州。

translations.literal: Secretariat Vice Director Cui Renshi was struck from the rolls and banished to Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Renshi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, was expelled from office and exiled to Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，西番沙缽羅葉護率眾歸附，以其俟斤屈裴祿為忠武將軍，兼大俟斤。

translations.literal: On guichou the Western Turks' Shaboluo Yehu led his people to submit; his yabghu Qu Baifu was made General of Loyal Valor and concurrently Great Yabghu.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Shaboluo Yehu of the Western Turks brought his people in; his yabghu Qu Baifu was made General of Loyal Valor and Great Yabghu as well.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以結骨部置堅昆都督。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Jiegu tribe was organized as the Jiankun Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Jiegu people were made the Jiankun Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸玉華宮，乙卯，賜所經高年篤疾粟帛有差。

translations.literal: On yihai he visited Jade Splendor Palace; on yimao he bestowed graded grain and silk on the aged and the gravely ill along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he went to Jade Splendor Palace; on yimao he gave graded gifts of grain and silk to the old and the seriously ill he passed along the way.

sentences.zh: 己卯，蒐於華原。

translations.literal: On jimao he conducted a hunt at Huayuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he hunted at Huayuan.

sentences.zh: 四月甲寅，磧外蕃人爭牧馬出界，上親臨斷決，然後咸服。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the fourth month, tribes beyond the desert disputed grazing and drove their horses across the border; the emperor went in person to judge the case, and only then did all submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the fourth month, frontier tribes beyond the sands quarreled over pasture and drove their herds across the line; the emperor judged the dispute himself, and all parties yielded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，右武候將軍梁建方擊松外蠻，下其部落七十二所。

translations.literal: On dingsi General Liang Jianfang of the Right Martial Guards attacked the Songwai barbarians and reduced seventy-two tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Liang Jianfang, general of the Right Martial Guards, struck the Songwai tribes and brought seventy-two of them to heel.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，右衛率長史王玄策擊帝那伏帝國，大破之，獲其王阿羅那順及王妃、子等，虜男女萬二千人、牛馬二萬餘以詣闕。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the fifth month, Chief Clerk Wang Xuance of the Right Guard attacked the kingdom of Diennafudi, routed it, and captured its king Arunasena together with the queen and princes; he brought twelve thousand men and women and more than twenty thousand cattle and horses to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fifth month Wang Xuance, chief clerk of the Right Guard, crushed the kingdom of Diennafudi, seized King Arunasena with his queen and sons, and presented at court twelve thousand captives and more than twenty thousand head of cattle and horses.

sentences.zh: 使方土那羅邇娑婆於金飆門造延年之藥。

translations.literal: He sent the alchemist Naluo'ersapo to compound an elixir of longevity at the Golden Gale Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the alchemist Naluo'ersapo to brew an elixir of long life at the Golden Gale Gate.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃贊普擊破中天竺國，遣使獻捷。

translations.literal: The Tibetan tsenpo broke central India and sent envoys bearing news of victory.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan tsenpo overran central India and sent envoys with word of triumph.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，特進、宋國公蕭瑀薨。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the sixth month, Senior Grand Master, Duke of Song Xiao Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the sixth month Xiao Yu, Senior Grand Master and Duke of Song, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，司空、梁國公房玄齡薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guimao, Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Fang Xuanling died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the seventh autumn month Fang Xuanling, Minister of Works and Duke of Liang, died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the first day of the eighth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，黃門侍郎褚遂良為中書令。

translations.literal: On jihai of the ninth month, Household Associate Attendant Chu Suiliang was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the ninth month Chu Suiliang, Household Associate Attendant, became Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 十月癸亥，至自玉華宮。

translations.literal: On guihai of the tenth month he returned from Jade Splendor Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the tenth month he came back from Jade Splendor Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，眉、邛、雅三州獠反，右衛將軍梁建方討平之。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the eleventh month the Liao of Mei, Qiong, and Ya prefectures rebelled; General Liang Jianfang of the Right Guard suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eleventh month the Liao of Mei, Qiong, and Ya rose; Liang Jianfang, general of the Right Guard, put them down.

sentences.zh: 庚子，契丹帥窟哥、奚帥可度者並率其部內屬。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Khitan chief Kuge and the Xi chief Keduzhe each led their tribes to submit within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Khitan leader Kuge and the Xi leader Keduzhe each brought his people inside the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以契丹部為松漠都督，以奚部置饒樂都督。

translations.literal: The Khitan were made the Songmo Protectorate; the Xi were organized as the Raole Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan became the Songmo Protectorate; the Xi were set up as the Raole Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，增置殿中侍御史、監察御史各二員，大理寺置平事十員。

translations.literal: On yimao of the twelfth month two additional Palace Attendant Censors and two Investigation Censors were appointed, and ten reviewers were established at the Court of Review.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the twelfth month the court added two Palace Attendant censors and two investigation censors, and placed ten reviewers in the Court of Review.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁丑朔，昆山道總管阿史那社爾降處密、處月，破龜茲大撥等五十城，虜數萬口，執龜茲王訶黎布失畢以歸，龜茲平，西域震駭。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary month, dingchou, Area Commander Ashina She'er of the Kunshan Circuit reduced Chumi and Chuyue, broke fifty Kucha cities including Dabo, captured tens of thousands, seized Kucha King Helibushibi and returned; Kucha was pacified and the Western Regions were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the first day of the intercalary month, Ashina She'er, commander of the Kunshan Circuit, subdued Chumi and Chuyue, stormed fifty Kucha strongholds including Dabo, took tens of thousands captive, and brought back King Helibushibi of Kucha; with Kucha pacified, the west trembled.

sentences.zh: 副將薛萬徹脅於闐王伏闍信入朝。

translations.literal: Vice-commander Xue Wanche compelled the king of Khotan, Fuxinxin, to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: His deputy Xue Wanche forced Fuxinxin, king of Khotan, to present himself at court.

sentences.zh: 癸未，新羅王遣其相伊贊千金春秋及其子文王來朝。

translations.literal: On guiwei the king of Silla sent his minister Ichan Geum Chunchu and his son Prince Munwang to court.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Silla's king sent his minister Ichan Geum Chunchu and his son Prince Munwang to pay court.

sentences.zh: 是歲，新羅女王金善德死，遣冊立其妹真德為新羅王。

translations.literal: That year Queen Jinseondeok of Silla died; an envoy was sent to install her sister Jindeok as king of Silla.
translations.idiomatic: That year Queen Jinseondeok of Silla died; the court sent envoys to enthrone her sister Jindeok as ruler of Silla.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十三年二十三年春正月辛亥，俘龜茲王訶黎布失畢及其相那利等，獻於社廟。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Zhenguan, in the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on xinhai, the captive Kucha king Helibushibi and his minister Nali and others were presented at the state temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Zhenguan, on xinhai of the first spring month, King Helibushibi of Kucha and his minister Nali, already prisoners, were offered at the state temple.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，置瑤池都督府，隸安西都護府。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the second month the Yaozhou Protectorate was established, subordinate to the Anxi Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the second month the Yaozhou Protectorate was created under Anxi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，西突厥肆葉護可汗遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Western Turk khan Siyehu sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Khan Siyehu of the Western Turks sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，置豐州都督府。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the third month the Fengzhou Protectorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the third month the Fengzhou Protectorate was established.

sentences.zh: 自去冬不雨，至於此月己未乃雨。

translations.literal: From the previous winter there had been no rain; only on jiwei of this month did rain fall.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had failed since the previous winter; not until jiwei of this month did the sky break.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinyou there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，敕皇太子於金液門聽政。

translations.literal: On dingmao the crown prince was ordered to hear government at the Golden Liquid Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he commanded the crown prince to conduct affairs at the Golden Liquid Gate.

sentences.zh: 是月，日赤無光。

translations.literal: That month the sun was dull and without radiance.
translations.idiomatic: That month the sun burned red but cast no light.

sentences.zh: 四月己亥，幸翠微宮。

translations.literal: On jihai of the fourth month he visited Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fourth month he went to Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，太子詹事、英國公李勣為疊州都督。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the fifth month, Crown Prince Tutor, Duke of England Li Ji was made Governor of Diezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fifth month Li Ji, crown prince tutor and Duke of England, was made governor of Diezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，開府儀同三司、衛國公李靖薨。

translations.literal: On xinyou Senior Grand Master, Duke of Wei Li Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Jing, Senior Grand Master and Duke of Wei, died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上崩於含風殿，年五十二。

translations.literal: On jisi the emperor died in Hanfeng Hall at the age of fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor died in Hanfeng Hall. He was fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 遺詔皇太子即位於柩前，喪紀宜用漢制。

translations.literal: His testament ordered the crown prince to succeed before the bier; mourning rites were to follow Han custom.
translations.idiomatic: His dying edict named the crown prince to take the throne before the coffin and directed that mourning follow Han usage.

sentences.zh: 秘不發喪。

translations.literal: The death was kept secret and no mourning was announced.
translations.idiomatic: The court concealed his death.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣舊將統飛騎勁兵從皇太子先還京，發六府甲士四千人，分列於道及安化門，翼從乃入；

translations.literal: On gengwu he sent veteran generals at the head of Flying Cavalry and picked troops to escort the crown prince back to the capital first; four thousand armored men of the six metropolitan offices were mobilized and posted along the road and at Anhua Gate, and only then did he enter under their wing;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he sent old commanders with Flying Cavalry and crack troops to bring the crown prince back to the capital ahead of the procession; four thousand armored men from the six metropolitan offices lined the road and Anhua Gate, and only under their escort did the heir enter;

sentences.zh: 大行御馬輿，從官侍御如常。

translations.literal: the late emperor's carriage and outriders went as on ordinary days, and attendants served as usual.
translations.idiomatic: the imperial carriage and its escort moved as on any other day, and the household staff kept their usual round.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發喪。

translations.literal: On renshen mourning was announced.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the death was made public.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌朔，殯於太極殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, jiaxu, the coffin lay in state in Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the first day of the sixth month, the coffin was set out in Taiji Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，百僚上謚曰文皇帝，廟號太宗。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the eighth month the officials proposed the posthumous title Emperor Wen; his temple name was Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eighth month the ministers offered the posthumous title Emperor Wen and the temple name Taizong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，葬昭陵。

translations.literal: On gengyin he was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he was interred at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 上元元年八月，改上尊號曰文武聖皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Shangyuan his elevated honorific was changed to Martial-Sage Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Shangyuan 1 his elevated title became Martial-Sage Emperor.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載二月，改上尊號為文武大聖大廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Tianbao his elevated honorific was changed to Martial Great Sage, Greatly Broad and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tianbao 13 his honorific was raised to Martial Great Sage, Greatly Broad and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 【史評】史臣曰：臣觀文皇帝發跡多奇，聰明神武。

translations.literal: [Historian's appraisal] The historian says: I observe that in his rise Emperor Wen showed many strange turns of fortune and was brilliantly wise and divinely martial.
translations.idiomatic: [Historian's appraisal] The historian writes: In his rise Emperor Wen met fortune at every odd turn; his mind was bright and his war-craft godlike.

sentences.zh: 拔人物則不私於黨，負志業則咸盡其才。

translations.literal: In raising men he did not favor his faction; in burdening them with tasks he used all their talent to the full.
translations.idiomatic: He chose men without party favor and set each to the work that fit his gift.

sentences.zh: 所以屈突、尉遲，由仇敵而願傾心膂；

translations.literal: Hence Qu Tu and Yuchi, though once enemies, came to offer him their hearts and sinews;
translations.idiomatic: So Qu Tu and Yuchi, once his foes, gave him heart and arm;

sentences.zh: 馬周、劉洎，自疏遠而卒委鈞衡。

translations.literal: Ma Zhou and Liu Ji, though at first remote from him, in the end were entrusted with the scales of power.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhou and Liu Ji, strangers at first, ended holding the balances of state.

sentences.zh: 終平泰階，諒由斯道。

translations.literal: In the end he settled the heavenly stairs—surely by this path.
translations.idiomatic: At last the realm stood level under heaven, and by this road alone.

sentences.zh: 嘗試論之：礎潤雲興，蟲鳴螽躍。

translations.literal: I once tried to reason about it: when the foundation is damp the clouds rise; when insects stir the locusts leap.
translations.idiomatic: Consider this: damp the footings and clouds gather; stir the soil and the locusts leap.

sentences.zh: 雖堯、舜之聖，不能用檮杌、窮奇而治平；

translations.literal: Though Yao and Shun were sages, they could not govern in peace while employing Taowu and Qiongqi;
translations.idiomatic: Yao and Shun were sages, yet they could not rule in peace with Taowu and Qiongqi at court;

sentences.zh: 伊、呂之賢，不能為夏桀、殷辛而昌盛。

translations.literal: though Yi Yin and Lü Shang were worthies, they could not make Xia Jie and Yin Xin flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Yin and Lü Wang were worthies, yet they could not save Jie of Xia or Xin of Yin.

sentences.zh: 君臣之際，遭遇斯難，以至抉目剖心，蟲流筋擢，良由遭值之異也。

translations.literal: Between lord and minister, to meet such difficulty is hard; it can go as far as gouging out eyes and cutting out hearts, worms crawling through sinews pulled taut—truly because the times they meet differ.
translations.idiomatic: Between ruler and minister the meeting is perilous, even to eyes torn out and hearts laid open, sinews drawn till worms crawl the wound—such is the difference of the hour.

sentences.zh: 以房、魏之智，不逾於丘、軻，遂能尊主庇民者，遭時也。

translations.literal: Fang and Wei in wisdom did not surpass Confucius and Mencius, yet they could honor their lord and shelter the people—because the time served them.
translations.idiomatic: Fang and Wei were no wiser than Confucius or Mencius, yet they upheld their sovereign and shielded the people—because the age asked it of them.

sentences.zh: 或曰：以太宗之賢，失愛於昆弟，失教於諸子，何也？

translations.literal: Someone asked: If Taizong was so worthy, why did he lose the love of his brothers and fail in teaching his sons?
translations.idiomatic: Some ask: Taizong was so able—why did he lose his brothers' love and fail with his sons?

sentences.zh: 曰：然，舜不能仁四罪，堯不能訓丹硃，斯前志也。

translations.literal: He said: So it is. Shun could not make the Four Criminals humane; Yao could not instruct Danzhu—so the old records run.
translations.idiomatic: The answer is: So it is. Shun could not humanize the Four Criminals; Yao could not school Danzhu—the ancients said as much.

sentences.zh: 當神堯任讒之年，建成忌功之日，茍除畏逼，孰顧分崩，變故之興，間不容發，方懼「毀巢」之禍，寧虞「尺布」之謠？

translations.literal: In the years when Shenyao trusted slander and Jiancheng envied merit, if one merely removed what he feared, who would spare a thought for the realm splitting apart? When disaster rose there was no room between heartbeats; he first dreaded the calamity of "destroying the nest," how could he yet worry the tale of "a foot of cloth"?
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu heeded slander and Jiancheng grudged his merit, to cut off fear was all; who had leisure for the realm's cracking apart? Crisis allowed no breath between beats—he feared first the nest torn down, not yet the ballad of brothers measuring cloth.

sentences.zh: 承乾之愚，聖父不能移也。

translations.literal: Chengqian's folly—even a sage father could not move it.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqian's dullness not even a sage father could shift.

sentences.zh: 若文皇自定儲於哲嗣，不騁志於高麗；

translations.literal: Had Emperor Wen himself fixed the succession on a wise heir and not let his will run to Goguryeo;
translations.idiomatic: Had Taizong named a wise heir early and not poured his will into Goguryeo;

sentences.zh: 用人如貞觀之初，納諫比魏徵之日。

translations.literal: had he employed men as in the opening of Zhenguan and taken remonstrance as in the days of Wei Zheng—
translations.idiomatic: had he used men as at Zhenguan's dawn and heard remonstrance as in Wei Zheng's day—

sentences.zh: 況周發、周成之世襲，我有遺妍；

translations.literal: to say nothing of the hereditary reigns of King Fa and King Cheng of Zhou, in which we still left something to be desired;
translations.idiomatic: and even beside the hereditary peace of Fa and Cheng of Zhou, we would still have had faults to mend;

sentences.zh: 較漢文、漢武之恢弘，彼多慚德。

translations.literal: compared with the breadth of Han Wendi and Han Wudi, they would more often have had cause for shame.
translations.idiomatic: set against the scope of Han Wen and Han Wu, they would more often blush for their deeds.

sentences.zh: 跡其聽斷不惑，從善如流，千載可稱，一人而已！

translations.literal: Trace his judgments, never confused; his yielding to good counsel, swift as a stream—worthy of praise for a thousand years, a man alone!
translations.idiomatic: Yet trace how clear he was in judgment, how swift to follow what was right—a name for a thousand years, one man alone!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：昌、發啟國，一門三聖。

translations.literal: [Eulogy] The eulogy says: Chang and Fa opened the state; one house, three sages.
translations.idiomatic: [Eulogy] The eulogy says: Chang and Fa founded the line; one clan, three holy kings.

sentences.zh: 文定高位，友於不令。

translations.literal: Wen fixed the high seat; brotherly love was not well kept.
translations.idiomatic: Wen secured the throne; brotherhood was not kept whole.

sentences.zh: 管、蔡既誅，成、康道正。

translations.literal: Once Guan and Cai were put to death, Cheng and Kang walked the straight Way.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and Cai fell; then Cheng and Kang held the true path.

sentences.zh: 貞觀之風，到今歌詠。

translations.literal: The wind of Zhenguan—still sung to this day.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenguan wind—men still sing it now.
